scripts.title: Timebomb Pro Hub
scripts.script:
-- الخدمات الأساسية
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

-- إزالة أي واجهة سابقة لمنع التكرار
if CoreGui:FindFirstChild("TimebombProGUI") then
    CoreGui.TimebombProGUI:Destroy()
end

-- إنشاء الواجهة الرئيسية
local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
ScreenGui.Name = "TimebombProGUI"
pcall(function() ScreenGui.Parent = CoreGui end)
if not ScreenGui.Parent then
    ScreenGui.Parent = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
end
ScreenGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true

-- خلفية القائمة الرئيسية (تغطي الشاشة بتعتيم فخم)
local MainFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
MainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
MainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(5, 5, 5)
MainFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.5
MainFrame.Parent = ScreenGui

-- نافذة الخيارات المركزية بتصميم احترافي (Glassmorphism & Modern Dark)
local CenterBox = Instance.new("Frame")
CenterBox.Size = UDim2.new(0, 400, 0, 260)
CenterBox.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -200, 0.5, -130)
CenterBox.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 18)
CenterBox.BorderSizePixel = 0
CenterBox.Parent = MainFrame

local BoxCorner = Instance.new("UICorner", CenterBox)
BoxCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 16)

local UIStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", CenterBox)
UIStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(70, 130, 255)
UIStroke.Thickness = 1.5

-- عنوان القائمة الاحترافي
local Title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
Title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 60)
Title.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 10)
Title.Text = "TIMEBOMB • CONTROLLER"
Title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 255)
Title.TextSize = 18
Title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
Title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
Title.Parent = CenterBox

-- زر إخفاء الرأس ورجل (تصميم احترافي)
local QualityBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
QualityBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 340, 0, 50)
QualityBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -170, 0.32, 0)
QualityBtn.Text = "اخفاء الراس ورجل"
QualityBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
QualityBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 30)
QualityBtn.TextSize = 15
QualityBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamSemibold
QualityBtn.Parent = CenterBox
Instance.new("UICorner", QualityBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
local stroke1 = Instance.new("UIStroke", QualityBtn)
stroke1.Color = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 60)
stroke1.Thickness = 1

-- زر الأوتو (تصميم احترافي)
local AutoBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
AutoBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 340, 0, 50)
AutoBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -170, 0.58, 0)
AutoBtn.Text = "الأوتو"
AutoBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
AutoBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 30)
AutoBtn.TextSize = 15
AutoBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamSemibold
AutoBtn.Parent = CenterBox
Instance.new("UICorner", AutoBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
local stroke2 = Instance.new("UIStroke", AutoBtn)
stroke2.Color = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 60)
stroke2.Thickness = 1

-- متغيرات التحكم
local autoEnabled = false
local floatingAutoBtn = nil

-- دالة لإخفاء القائمة الكبيرة بسلاسة تامة
local function fadeOutAndDestroy()
    task.spawn(function()
        for i = 0, 1, 0.1 do
            MainFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.5 + (0.5 * i)
            CenterBox.BackgroundTransparency = i
            Title.TextTransparency = i
            QualityBtn.TextTransparency = i
            QualityBtn.BackgroundTransparency = i
            AutoBtn.TextTransparency = i
            AutoBtn.BackgroundTransparency = i
            task.wait(0.02)
        end
        MainFrame.Visible = false
    end)
end

-- تفعيل ميزة إخفاء الرأس والرجل اليمين بشكل دائم (حتى بعد الموت والعودة للحياة)
local function applyQualityFeatures()
    local function modifyCharacter(char)
        if not char then return end
        
        -- مراقبة الرأس وإخفائه فوراً ودائماً
        local head = char:WaitForChild("Head", 3)
        if head then 
            head.Transparency = 1 
            head.CanCollide = false 
            for _, v in ipairs(head:GetChildren()) do
                if v:IsA("Decal") then v.Transparency = 1 end
            end
        end
        
        -- مراقبة الرجل اليمين وإخفائها فوراً ودائماً
        local rightLegNames = {"Right Leg", "RightLowerLeg", "RightUpperLeg", "RightFoot"}
        for _, legName in ipairs(rightLegNames) do
            local leg = char:WaitForChild(legName, 3)
            if leg then
                leg.Transparency = 1
                leg.CanCollide = false
            end
        end
        
        -- إعادة تطبيق التعديل إذا تم عمل ريست أو الموت والعودة
        local humanoid = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 3)
        if humanoid then
            humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
                -- يتم إعادة التفعيل تلقائياً عند الموت عبر CharacterAdded
            end)
        end
    end

    if LocalPlayer.Character then
        modifyCharacter(LocalPlayer.Character)
    end
    
    LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
        task.wait(0.3) -- انتظار تحميل الشخصية بالكامل بعد الموت
        modifyCharacter(char)
    end)
end

-- إنشاء زر الأوتو المتحرك (شكل احترافي فخم وقابل للسحب لأي مكان)
local function createDraggableAutoButton()
    if floatingAutoBtn then return end
    
    floatingAutoBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    floatingAutoBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 150, 0, 45)
    floatingAutoBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.05, 0, 0.7, 0)
    floatingAutoBtn.Text = "AUTOBOMB: OFF"
    floatingAutoBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100)
    floatingAutoBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 18, 22)
    floatingAutoBtn.TextSize = 13
    floatingAutoBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    floatingAutoBtn.Parent = ScreenGui
    
    Instance.new("UICorner", floatingAutoBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)
    local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", floatingAutoBtn)
    stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80)
    stroke.Thickness = 1.5

    -- جعل الزر قابلاً للتحرك في كل مكان بسلاسة (يمين، يسار، فوق، تحت)
    local dragging, dragInput, dragStart, startPos
    
    floatingAutoBtn.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragging = true
            dragStart = input.Position
            startPos = floatingAutoBtn.Position
            
            input.Changed:Connect(function()
                if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                    dragging = false
                end
            end)
        end
    end)

    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
            local delta = input.Position - dragStart
            floatingAutoBtn.Position = UDim2.new(
                startPos.X.Scale, 
                startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, 
                startPos.Y.Scale, 
                startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
            )
        end
    end)

    -- تشغيل وإيقاف الأوتو بتصميم تفاعلي
    floatingAutoBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        autoEnabled = not autoEnabled
        if autoEnabled then
            floatingAutoBtn.Text = "AUTOBOMB: ON"
            floatingAutoBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 255, 100)
            stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(80, 255, 80)
        else
            floatingAutoBtn.Text = "AUTOBOMB: OFF"
            floatingAutoBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100)
            stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80)
        end
    end)
end

-- ربط الأزرار بالوظائف
QualityBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    fadeOutAndDestroy()
    applyQualityFeatures()
end)

AutoBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    fadeOutAndDestroy()
    createDraggableAutoButton()
end)

-- نظام الأوتو الذكي (تتبع الخصم الحقيقي بدقة وتجاهل زملاء الفريق)
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if not autoEnabled then return end
    
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not char or not char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return end
    
    local humanoid = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return end
    
    -- فحص ما إذا كان اللاعب يحمل القنبلة
    local hasBomb = char:FindFirstChild("Bomb") or LocalPlayer.Backpack:FindFirstChild("Bomb")
    
    if hasBomb then
        local targetPlayer = nil
        local shortestDistance = math.huge
        
        for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if player ~= LocalPlayer and player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
                local pHumanoid = player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                
                if pHumanoid and pHumanoid.Health > 0 then
                    -- استثناء الزملاء في نفس الفريق تماماً
                    local isTeamMate = false
                    if LocalPlayer.Team and player.Team and LocalPlayer.Team == player.Team then
                        isTeamMate = true
                    end
                    
                    if not isTeamMate and pHumanoid.WalkSpeed <= 35 then
                        local enemyRoot = player.Character.HumanoidRootPart
                        local dist = (char.HumanoidRootPart.Position - enemyRoot.Position).Magnitude
                        
                        -- فحص العوائق والجدران عبر Raycast
                        local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
                        raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {char, player.Character}
                        raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
                        
                        local raycastResult = Workspace:Raycast(char.HumanoidRootPart.Position, (enemyRoot.Position - char.HumanoidRootPart.Position), raycastParams)
                        
                        if not raycastResult or dist < 12 then
                            if dist < shortestDistance then
                                shortestDistance = dist
                                targetPlayer = player
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        
        -- التوجه حصرياً نحو الخصم المستهدف
        if targetPlayer and targetPlayer.Character and targetPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
            humanoid:MoveTo(targetPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position)
        end
    end
end)

scripts.script:
--[[
	WARNING: Heads up! This script has not been verified by ScriptBlox. Use at your own risk!
]]
local Players          = game:GetService("Players")
	local UIS              = game:GetService("UserInputService")
	local RunService       = game:GetService("RunService")
	local Lighting         = game:GetService("Lighting")
	local TeleportService  = game:GetService("TeleportService")
	local player           = Players.LocalPlayer

	local DISCORD_URL = "https://discord.gg/Qe9Z2zX2G"
	local GATE_SECONDS = 15

	local uc = {
		Panel     = Color3.fromRGB(10, 8, 8),
		Surface   = Color3.fromRGB(24, 10, 10),
		SurfaceHi = Color3.fromRGB(38, 14, 14),
		Border    = Color3.fromRGB(96, 28, 28),
		Text      = Color3.fromRGB(245, 235, 235),
		Muted     = Color3.fromRGB(170, 120, 120),
		On        = Color3.fromRGB(220, 55, 55),
		Discord   = Color3.fromRGB(200, 35, 35),
	}

	local function make(className, props, parent)
		local inst = Instance.new(className)
		for k, v in pairs(props) do inst[k] = v end
		inst.Parent = parent
		return inst
	end

	local function corner(parent, radius)
		make("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius) }, parent)
	end

	local function copyDiscord()
		local ok = pcall(function()
			if setclipboard then
				setclipboard(DISCORD_URL)
			elseif toclipboard then
				toclipboard(DISCORD_URL)
			end
		end)
		return ok
	end

	-- ---------- feature state ----------
	local infJumpConn, noclipConn, flyConn, flyBV
	local savedLighting
	local savedSpeed, savedJumpPower, savedUseJumpPower
	local speedBoostOn, jumpPowerOn = false, false

	local function setInfiniteJump(on)
		if infJumpConn then infJumpConn:Disconnect(); infJumpConn = nil end
		if not on then return end
		infJumpConn = UIS.JumpRequest:Connect(function()
			local char = player.Character
			local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if hum and hum.Health > 0 then
				hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
			end
		end)
	end

	local function setNoclip(on)
		if noclipConn then noclipConn:Disconnect(); noclipConn = nil end
		if not on then return end
		noclipConn = RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
			local char = player.Character
			if not char then return end
			for _, p in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
				if p:IsA("BasePart") and p.CanCollide then
					p.CanCollide = false
				end
			end
		end)
	end

	local function setFullbright(on)
		if on then
			if not savedLighting then
				savedLighting = {
					Brightness     = Lighting.Brightness,
					ClockTime      = Lighting.ClockTime,
					Ambient        = Lighting.Ambient,
					OutdoorAmbient = Lighting.OutdoorAmbient,
					FogEnd         = Lighting.FogEnd,
					GlobalShadows  = Lighting.GlobalShadows,
				}
			end
			Lighting.Brightness     = 3
			Lighting.ClockTime      = 14
			Lighting.Ambient        = Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 180)
			Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 180)
			Lighting.FogEnd         = 1e6
			Lighting.GlobalShadows  = false
		elseif savedLighting then
			for k, v in pairs(savedLighting) do
				pcall(function() Lighting[k] = v end)
			end
			savedLighting = nil
		end
	end

	local function setFly(on)
		if flyConn then flyConn:Disconnect(); flyConn = nil end
		if flyBV   then flyBV:Destroy();      flyBV   = nil end
		if not on then return end
		local char = player.Character
		local hum  = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local root = hum and hum.RootPart
		if not root then return end
		local bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
		bv.Name = "HackingBrosFly"
		bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e5, 1e5, 1e5)
		bv.Velocity = Vector3.zero
		bv.Parent = root
		flyBV = bv
		local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
		flyConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
			if not flyBV or not flyBV.Parent then return end
			local dir = Vector3.zero
			if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W)           then dir = dir + cam.CFrame.LookVector   end
			if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S)           then dir = dir - cam.CFrame.LookVector   end
			if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A)           then dir = dir - cam.CFrame.RightVector  end
			if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D)           then dir = dir + cam.CFrame.RightVector  end
			if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space)       then dir = dir + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)    end
			if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl) then dir = dir - Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)    end
			flyBV.Velocity = dir.Magnitude > 0 and dir.Unit * 60 or Vector3.zero
		end)
	end

	local function setSpeedBoost(on)
		speedBoostOn = on
		local char = player.Character
		local hum  = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if not hum then return end
		if on then
			if savedSpeed == nil then savedSpeed = hum.WalkSpeed end
			hum.WalkSpeed = 100
		elseif savedSpeed ~= nil then
			hum.WalkSpeed = savedSpeed
			savedSpeed = nil
		end
	end

	local function setJumpPower(on)
		jumpPowerOn = on
		local char = player.Character
		local hum  = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if not hum then return end
		if on then
			if savedJumpPower == nil then
				savedJumpPower    = hum.JumpPower
				savedUseJumpPower = hum.UseJumpPower
			end
			hum.UseJumpPower = true
			hum.JumpPower    = 120
		elseif savedJumpPower ~= nil then
			hum.JumpPower     = savedJumpPower
			hum.UseJumpPower  = savedUseJumpPower
			savedJumpPower    = nil
			savedUseJumpPower = nil
		end
	end

	local function resetCharacter()
		local char = player.Character
		local hum  = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if hum then hum.Health = 0 end
	end

	local function rejoinServer()
		pcall(function()
			TeleportService:Teleport(game.PlaceId, player)
		end)
	end

	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
		local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5)
		if not hum then return end
		if speedBoostOn then hum.WalkSpeed = 100 end
		if jumpPowerOn then
			hum.UseJumpPower = true
			hum.JumpPower    = 120
		end
	end)

	-- =========================================================
	-- SPLASH — 15 second Discord gate
	-- =========================================================
	local function showSplash(onDone)

			if flyConn     then flyConn:Disconnect();     flyConn     = nil end
			if flyBV       then flyBV:Destroy();          flyBV       = nil end
			setFullbright(false)
			screen2:Destroy()
		end)

		-- -- drag
		local dragging, dragInput, dragStart, startPos
		header2.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
			if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
				or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
				dragging  = true
				dragInput = input
				dragStart = input.Position
				startPos  = panel2.Position
			end
		end)
		UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
			if dragging and (input == dragInput
				or (dragInput.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
					and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement)) then
				local delta = input.Position - dragStart
				panel2.Position = UDim2.new(
					startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
					startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y

			end
		end)
		UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
			if input == dragInput then
				dragging  = false
				dragInput = nil
			end
		end)

scripts.title: Safe-SlientAim open-source
scripts.script:
--safe
--!native
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Env = (getgenv and getgenv()) or _G

if Env.BallisticSilentAimState and Env.BallisticSilentAimState.Cleanup then
	Env.BallisticSilentAimState.Cleanup()
end

local State = {
	Active = true,
	OriginalAimDirection = nil :: ((Vector3) -> Vector3)?,
	OriginalAssistDirection = nil :: ((Vector3, Vector3, boolean?) -> Vector3)?,
	OriginalAimPoint = nil :: ((number?) -> (Vector3, RaycastResult?))?,
}

local function ResolveCombatFolder(): Instance?
	local playerScripts = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerScripts")
	if playerScripts then
		local combatFolder = playerScripts:FindFirstChild("Combat")
		if combatFolder then
			return combatFolder
		end
	end
	return LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("Combat")
end

local CombatFolder = ResolveCombatFolder()
local SharedFolder = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared", 10)

local UtilModule = if CombatFolder and CombatFolder:FindFirstChild("Util")
	then require(CombatFolder.Util)
	else nil
local CombatShared = if SharedFolder and SharedFolder:FindFirstChild("Combat")
	then require(SharedFolder.Combat)
	else nil

local ControllerStateTable: { [any]: any }? = nil
if filtergc then
	local matches = filtergc("table", { Keys = { "shotId", "killStreak", "pressed" } }, true)
	if type(matches) == "table" and #matches > 0 then
		ControllerStateTable = matches[1]
	end
elseif getgc then
	for _, v in getgc(true) do
		if type(v) ~= "table" then
			continue
		end
		if rawget(v, "shotId") ~= nil and rawget(v, "killStreak") ~= nil and rawget(v, "pressed") ~= nil then
			ControllerStateTable = v
			break
		end
	end
end

local function GetActiveProjectilePhysics(): (number, number)
	local speed = 180
	local gravity = 60

	if ControllerStateTable then
		local handler = rawget(ControllerStateTable, "handler")
		if type(handler) == "table" then
			local tuning = rawget(handler, "tuning")
			if type(tuning) == "table" then
				local g = rawget(tuning, "gravity")
				if type(g) == "number" then
					gravity = g
				end

				local charge = 1
				local chargeFn = rawget(handler, "Charge") or (getmetatable(handler) and rawget(getmetatable(handler), "Charge"))
				if type(chargeFn) == "function" then
					local ok, c = pcall(chargeFn, handler)
					if ok and type(c) == "number" and c > 0 then
						charge = c
					end
				end

				if CombatShared and type(rawget(CombatShared, "DrawnShot")) == "function" then
					local ok, _, drawnSpeed = pcall(rawget(CombatShared, "DrawnShot"), tuning, charge)
					if ok and type(drawnSpeed) == "number" and drawnSpeed > 0 then
						speed = drawnSpeed
					end
				elseif type(rawget(tuning, "speed")) == "number" then
					speed = rawget(tuning, "speed")
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return speed, gravity
end

local function FindBestTarget(origin: Vector3): (BasePart?, Model?)
	if not UtilModule then
		return nil, nil
	end

	local targetsFn = rawget(UtilModule, "Targets")
	local canPredictFn = rawget(UtilModule, "CanPredictHit")
	local worldParamsFn = rawget(UtilModule, "WorldParams")
	if type(targetsFn) ~= "function" then
		return nil, nil
	end

	local targets = targetsFn()
	local rayParams = if type(worldParamsFn) == "function" then worldParamsFn(targets) else nil

	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local camLook = if camera then camera.CFrame.LookVector else Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)

	local bestPart: BasePart? = nil
	local bestModel: Model? = nil
	local bestScore = math.huge

	for _, model in targets do
		if typeof(model) ~= "Instance" or not model:IsA("Model") then
			continue
		end

		if type(canPredictFn) == "function" and not canPredictFn(model) then
			continue
		end

		local hum = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then
			continue
		end

		local head = model:FindFirstChild("Head")
		local root = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local targetPart: BasePart? = if head and head:IsA("BasePart")
			then head
			elseif root and root:IsA("BasePart") then root
			else nil

		if not targetPart then
			continue
		end

		local delta = targetPart.Position - origin
		local dist = delta.Magnitude
		if dist < 1 or dist > 450 then
			continue
		end

		if rayParams then
			local hit = workspace:Raycast(origin, delta, rayParams)
			if hit and not hit.Instance:IsDescendantOf(model) then
				continue
			end
		end

		local dot = delta.Unit:Dot(camLook)
		local score = (1 - dot) * 120 + dist * 0.15
		if score < bestScore then
			bestScore = score
			bestPart = targetPart
			bestModel = model
		end
	end

	return bestPart, bestModel
end

local function ComputeBallisticAimPoint(origin: Vector3, targetPart: BasePart): Vector3
	local speed, gravity = GetActiveProjectilePhysics()
	local targetPos = targetPart.Position
	local velocity = targetPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity

	local dist = (targetPos - origin).Magnitude
	local flightTime = if speed > 1 then dist / speed else 0

	local predictedPos = targetPos + Vector3.new(velocity.X, velocity.Y * 0.35, velocity.Z) * flightTime
	flightTime = if speed > 1 then (predictedPos - origin).Magnitude / speed else 0

	local dropCompensation = 0.5 * gravity * (flightTime * flightTime)
	return predictedPos + Vector3.new(0, dropCompensation, 0)
end

if UtilModule and not table.isfrozen(UtilModule) then
	State.OriginalAimDirection = rawget(UtilModule, "AimDirection")
	State.OriginalAssistDirection = rawget(UtilModule, "AssistDirection")
	State.OriginalAimPoint = rawget(UtilModule, "AimPoint")

	rawset(UtilModule, "AimDirection", function(origin: Vector3): Vector3
		if State.Active and typeof(origin) == "Vector3" then
			local targetPart = FindBestTarget(origin)
			if targetPart then
				local aimPos = ComputeBallisticAimPoint(origin, targetPart)
				local delta = aimPos - origin
				if delta.Magnitude > 0.01 then
					return delta.Unit
				end
			end
		end
		if State.OriginalAimDirection then
			return State.OriginalAimDirection(origin)
		end
		return Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
	end)

	rawset(UtilModule, "AssistDirection", function(origin: Vector3, dir: Vector3, isArc: boolean?): Vector3
		if State.Active and typeof(origin) == "Vector3" then
			local targetPart = FindBestTarget(origin)
			if targetPart then
				local aimPos = ComputeBallisticAimPoint(origin, targetPart)
				local delta = aimPos - origin
				if delta.Magnitude > 0.01 then
					return delta.Unit
				end
			end
		end
		if State.OriginalAssistDirection then
			return State.OriginalAssistDirection(origin, dir, isArc)
		end
		return dir
	end)

	rawset(UtilModule, "AimPoint", function(range: number?): (Vector3, RaycastResult?)
		if State.Active then
			local char = LocalPlayer.Character
			local head = char and char:FindFirstChild("Head")
			local origin = if head and head:IsA("BasePart")
				then head.Position
				elseif workspace.CurrentCamera then workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.Position
				else Vector3.zero

			local targetPart = FindBestTarget(origin)
			if targetPart then
				return ComputeBallisticAimPoint(origin, targetPart), nil
			end
		end
		if State.OriginalAimPoint then
			return State.OriginalAimPoint(range)
		end
		return Vector3.zero, nil
	end)
end

State.Cleanup = function()
	State.Active = false
	if UtilModule and not table.isfrozen(UtilModule) then
		if State.OriginalAimDirection then
			rawset(UtilModule, "AimDirection", State.OriginalAimDirection)
		end
		if State.OriginalAssistDirection then
			rawset(UtilModule, "AssistDirection", State.OriginalAssistDirection)
		end
		if State.OriginalAimPoint then
			rawset(UtilModule, "AimPoint", State.OriginalAimPoint)
		end
	end
end

Env.BallisticSilentAimState = State

scripts.features:
This Fishy Hub script for 1 Tap Simulator Reborn uses FishyUI and opens with RightShift, talking directly to the game’s RemoteServices remotes rather than a wrapper. Its Auto Farm tab covers tapping, server auto-click, hatching, rebirths, upgrades, skill-tree unlocking, physical upgrades, and double jump, with rate ceilings read from the game’s own configs. Pets handles equipping, bulk locking/deleting, pet teams, crafting machines, fusion, enchanting, index rewards, and pet power readouts. Teleports cover islands, zones, local landing points, saved positions, coordinates, and under-map recovery, while Collectibles handles tagged pickups, world events, hitbox expansion, and event pickups like balloons, pigs, meteors, and egg drops. Minigames includes Colosseum auto-attacks, Dig, Memory Match, Bouncy Obby, and Mining with lazy-content fetching. Items and Shop cover inventory use, boosts, totems, gifts, the event wheel, lucky blocks, potion/honey machines, shrine/weather dials, creator codes, token purchases, gamepass perks, and gifting. Quests and Social handle quest claims, NPC dialogs, offline rewards, mastery relics, titles, leaderboards, giveaways, raffles, trading, and clan upgrades. Visuals and Utility add ESP, movement, lighting, game settings, anti-AFK, server tools, data dumps, and a remote browser, while Dev adds a config browser, lazy-content loader, discovery of unknown remote payloads, and a remote spy. Logs keeps recent output, and Settings plus FishyUI’s addons manage theme and saved configs, with unload restoring overlays, hitboxes, and loops.

scripts.title: Jump buttom (jumpindex)
scripts.script:
--[[
    jumpindex.lua
    - ∞ OFF: clicar ⬆ = 1 pulo normal (ChangeState + velocidade, sai de cadeira/carro)
    - ∞ ON: SEGURAR ⬆ = pula infinitamente / soltar = para
    - Botão ⬆ pisca azul claro ao clicar no OFF
    - Anti-spam: ignora clique se não estiver no chão
--]]

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local antiga = playerGui:FindFirstChild("BotaoPularGui")
if antiga then antiga:Destroy() end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- SCREEN GUI
------------------------------------------------------------
local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Name = "BotaoPularGui"
screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
screenGui.IgnoreGuiInset = false
screenGui.DisplayOrder = 999
screenGui.Parent = playerGui

------------------------------------------------------------
-- FRAME PAI
------------------------------------------------------------
local mainFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
mainFrame.Name = "MainFrame"
mainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 60, 0, 90)
mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(1, -80, 0, 20)
mainFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
mainFrame.Parent = screenGui

------------------------------------------------------------
-- BOTÃO ⬆
------------------------------------------------------------
local container = Instance.new("Frame")
container.Name = "ContainerBotao"
container.Size = UDim2.new(0, 50, 0, 50)
container.Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, 0)
container.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 130, 255)
container.BorderSizePixel = 0
container.Parent = mainFrame

local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
corner.Parent = container

local gradient = Instance.new("UIGradient")
gradient.Color = ColorSequence.new({
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(80, 160, 255)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(20, 80, 200))
})
gradient.Rotation = 90
gradient.Parent = container

local botao = Instance.new("TextButton")
botao.Name = "BtnPular"
botao.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
botao.BackgroundTransparency = 1
botao.Text = "⬆"
botao.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
botao.TextScaled = true
botao.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
botao.AutoButtonColor = false
botao.Active = true
botao.Parent = container

local textSize = Instance.new("UITextSizeConstraint")
textSize.MaxTextSize = 30
textSize.Parent = botao

------------------------------------------------------------
-- TOGGLE ∞
------------------------------------------------------------
local toggleContainer = Instance.new("Frame")
toggleContainer.Name = "ContainerToggle"
toggleContainer.Size = UDim2.new(0, 50, 0, 22)
toggleContainer.Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, 60)
toggleContainer.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 45, 65)
toggleContainer.BorderSizePixel = 0
toggleContainer.Parent = mainFrame

local toggleCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
toggleCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
toggleCorner.Parent = toggleContainer

local toggleBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
toggleBtn.Name = "BtnToggle"
toggleBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
toggleBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
toggleBtn.Text = "∞ OFF"
toggleBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 200, 230)
toggleBtn.TextScaled = true
toggleBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
toggleBtn.AutoButtonColor = false
toggleBtn.Active = true
toggleBtn.Parent = toggleContainer

local toggleTextSize = Instance.new("UITextSizeConstraint")
toggleTextSize.MaxTextSize = 13
toggleTextSize.Parent = toggleBtn

------------------------------------------------------------
-- CORES
------------------------------------------------------------
local COR_AZUL_NORMAL = Color3.fromRGB(50, 130, 255)
local COR_AZUL_CLARO  = Color3.fromRGB(200, 230, 255)
local COR_VERDE_ARM   = Color3.fromRGB(40, 110, 70)
local COR_VERDE_ATIVO = Color3.fromRGB(80, 220, 120)

local GRAD_NORMAL = ColorSequence.new({
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(80, 160, 255)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(20, 80, 200))
})
local GRAD_CLARO = ColorSequence.new({
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(200, 230, 255)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(200, 230, 255))
})
local GRAD_ARM = ColorSequence.new({
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(60, 160, 100)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(20, 80, 50))
})
local GRAD_ATIVO = ColorSequence.new({
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 160)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(20, 140, 60))
})

------------------------------------------------------------
-- ESTADOS
------------------------------------------------------------
local infiniteArmado = false
local segurando      = false
local loopRodando    = false
local piscando       = false
local FORCA_PULO     = 50

------------------------------------------------------------
-- VISUAIS
------------------------------------------------------------
local function atualizarToggle()
    if infiniteArmado then
        toggleBtn.Text = "∞ ON"
        toggleBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 160)
        toggleContainer.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 70, 40)
    else
        toggleBtn.Text = "∞ OFF"
        toggleBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 200, 230)
        toggleContainer.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 45, 65)
    end
end

local function atualizarVisualBotao()
    if piscando then return end

    if segurando then
        container.BackgroundColor3 = COR_VERDE_ATIVO
        gradient.Color = GRAD_ATIVO
    elseif infiniteArmado then
        container.BackgroundColor3 = COR_VERDE_ARM
        gradient.Color = GRAD_ARM
    else
        container.BackgroundColor3 = COR_AZUL_NORMAL
        gradient.Color = GRAD_NORMAL
    end
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- PISCA AZUL CLARO
------------------------------------------------------------
local function piscarAzulClaro()
    piscando = true
    container.BackgroundColor3 = COR_AZUL_CLARO
    gradient.Color = GRAD_CLARO

    task.spawn(function()
        task.wait(0.15)
        piscando = false
        atualizarVisualBotao()
    end)
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- CHECA SE ESTÁ NO CHÃO
------------------------------------------------------------
local function estaNoChao(humanoid)
    local estado = humanoid:GetState()
    if estado == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping
    or estado == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall then
        return false
    end
    if humanoid.FloorMaterial == Enum.Material.Air then
        return false
    end
    return true
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- APLICA PULO (ChangeState + velocidade)
------------------------------------------------------------
local function aplicarPulo()
    local character = player.Character
    if not character then return end

    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local hrp = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not humanoid or not hrp then return end

    pcall(function()
        humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping, true)
        humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
    end)

    local vel = hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity
    hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(vel.X, FORCA_PULO, vel.Z)
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- PULO NORMAL (com debounce real)
------------------------------------------------------------
local ultimoPulo = 0
local COOLDOWN = 0.35

local function pularNormal()
    local agora = tick()
    if agora - ultimoPulo < COOLDOWN then return end

    local character = player.Character
    if not character then return end

    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not humanoid then return end

    -- Se está sentado (cadeira/carro), levanta e pula depois
    if humanoid.Sit then
        ultimoPulo = agora
        pcall(function()
            humanoid.Sit = false
        end)
        task.spawn(function()
            task.wait(0.08)
            local char = player.Character
            if not char then return end
            local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if not hum then return end
            if estaNoChao(hum) then
                aplicarPulo()
            end
        end)
        return
    end

    -- Só pula se estiver no chão (evita spam e voo no OFF)
    if not estaNoChao(humanoid) then return end

    ultimoPulo = agora
    aplicarPulo()
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- LOOP DO INFINITE
------------------------------------------------------------
local function loopInfinite()
    if loopRodando then return end
    loopRodando = true

    task.spawn(function()
        while segurando and infiniteArmado do
            local character = player.Character
            if character then
                local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                local hrp = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if humanoid and hrp then
                    pcall(function()
                        if humanoid.Sit then
                            humanoid.Sit = false
                        end
                    end)
                    pcall(function()
                        humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping, true)
                        humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
                    end)
                    local vel = hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity
                    hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(vel.X, FORCA_PULO, vel.Z)
                end
            end
            task.wait(0.05)
        end
        loopRodando = false
    end)
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- TOGGLE
------------------------------------------------------------
toggleBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    infiniteArmado = not infiniteArmado
    if not infiniteArmado then
        segurando = false
    end
    atualizarToggle()
    atualizarVisualBotao()
end)

------------------------------------------------------------
-- INPUT DO BOTÃO ⬆
------------------------------------------------------------
local function aoPressionar()
    if infiniteArmado then
        segurando = true
        atualizarVisualBotao()
        loopInfinite()
    else
        piscarAzulClaro()
        pularNormal()
    end
end

local function aoSoltar()
    if segurando then
        segurando = false
        atualizarVisualBotao()
    end
end

botao.MouseButton1Down:Connect(aoPressionar)
botao.MouseButton1Up:Connect(aoSoltar)

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
    or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        aoSoltar()
    end
end)

------------------------------------------------------------
-- INICIALIZAR
------------------------------------------------------------
atualizarToggle()
atualizarVisualBotao()
print("[jumpindex] Carregado!")

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local VirtualUser = game:GetService("VirtualUser")

--// Character anchoring
local function setAnchored(state)
	anchored = state

	local character = player.Character
	if not character then return end

	local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if root then
		root.Anchored = state
	end
end

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
	local root = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

	-- Keep the selected anchor state after respawning
	root.Anchored = anchored
end)

--// Anti-AFK
player.Idled:Connect(function()
	if antiAFK then
		VirtualUser:CaptureController()
		VirtualUser:ClickButton2(Vector2.new(0, 0))
	end
end)

local ARROWS = { "12", "1:30", "3", "4:30", "6", "7:30", "9", "10:30" }
local function arrowFor(cam, pos)
	local rel = cam.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(pos)
	local a = math.atan2(rel.X, -rel.Z)
	local idx = math.floor((a + math.pi / 8) / (math.pi / 4)) % 8 + 1
	return ARROWS[idx]
end

local function getCamera() return workspace.CurrentCamera end
local function getRoot(char) return char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") end
local function getHum(char) return char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") end

local function isAlive(char)
	local hum = getHum(char)
	return hum ~= nil and hum.Health > 0
end

local function isTeammate(plr)
	return plr ~= nil and player.Team ~= nil and plr.Team == player.Team
end

local function getAimPart(char)
	local idx = S.AimPart
	local part
	if idx == 1 then
		part = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
	elseif idx == 2 then
		part = char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or char:FindFirstChild("Torso")
	end
	return part or char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end

local function scanNPCs()
	local list = {}
	for _, inst in workspace:GetDescendants() do
		if inst:IsA("Humanoid") then
			local char = inst.Parent
			if char and char ~= player.Character and not Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(char) then
				list[#list + 1] = char
			end
		end
	end
	npcList = list
end

local function collect(ignoreTeam)
	local out = {}
	for _, plr in Players:GetPlayers() do
		if plr ~= player and plr.Character and not (ignoreTeam and isTeammate(plr)) then
			out[#out + 1] = { char = plr.Character, plr = plr }
		end
	end
	if S.IncludeNPCs then
		for _, char in npcList do
			if char.Parent then out[#out + 1] = { char = char } end
		end
	end
	return out
end

	c.Parent = parent

	return l
end

	if applyVisuals then applyVisuals() end
	if key == "Coins" and startCoinLoop then startCoinLoop() end

		notify(toggleLabels[key], value)
	end
end

local function toast(text, color, force, life)
	if not S.Toasts and not force then return end
	local t = Instance.new("TextLabel")

	t.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 28)
	t.BackgroundColor3 = C_BG
	t.BackgroundTransparency = 1

	t.TextColor3 = color or C_TEXT
	t.TextTransparency = 1
	t.Font = FONT_B
	t.TextSize = 13
	t.Parent = UI.toasts
	corner(t, 14)
	local ts = addStroke(t, C_LINE, 1, 1)
	tween(t, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.05, TextTransparency = 0 })
	tween(ts, { Transparency = 0.5 })
	task.delay(life or 1.8, function()
		tween(t, { BackgroundTransparency = 1, TextTransparency = 1 }, TweenInfo.new(0.2))
		tween(ts, { Transparency = 1 }, TweenInfo.new(0.2))
		task.delay(0.25, function() t:Destroy() end)
	end)
end

local function safeRun(name, fn)
	local ok, err = pcall(fn)
	if not ok then
		warn("[ZENITH] " .. name .. ": " .. tostring(err))
		local msg = tostring(err)
		if #msg > 70 then msg = string.sub(msg, 1, 70) .. "…" end
		pcall(toast, "" .. name .. ": " .. msg, Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 90), true, 12)
	end
end

local lastNote = {}
local function defNote(key, enabled, src, color, every, ...)
	if not enabled then return end
	local now = os.clock()
	if now - (lastNote[key] or 0) < (every or 2) then return end
	lastNote[key] = now
	local text = select("#", ...) > 0 and string.format(tr(src), ...) or tr(src)
	toast(text, color or ACCENT, true)
end

local menuOpenState = false
local menuTween, menuRest = nil, nil
local function openMenu(open)
	if open == nil then open = not menuOpenState end
	local win = UI.window
	if open == menuOpenState and win.Visible == open then
		if applyVisuals then applyVisuals() end
		return
	end
	menuOpenState = open
	if menuTween then menuTween:Cancel() menuTween = nil end

	if not menuRest or not win.Visible then menuRest = win.Position end
	local rest = menuRest
	local w = win.Size.X.Offset * UI.scale.Scale + 40
	local away = UDim2.new(rest.X.Scale, rest.X.Offset - w, rest.Y.Scale, rest.Y.Offset)

	if open then
		if not win.Visible then win.Position = away end
		win.Visible = true
		menuTween = TweenService:Create(win, TweenInfo.new(0.22, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Position = rest })
		menuTween.Completed:Connect(function(state)
			if state == Enum.PlaybackState.Completed then
				win.Position = rest
				menuRest = nil
			end
		end)
		menuTween:Play()
	else
		overMenu = false
		local tw = TweenService:Create(win, TweenInfo.new(0.14, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.In), { Position = away })
		menuTween = tw
		tw.Completed:Connect(function(state)
			if state == Enum.PlaybackState.Completed and not menuOpenState then
				win.Visible = false
				win.Position = rest
				menuRest = nil
				if applyVisuals then applyVisuals() end
			end
		end)
		tw:Play()
	end
	if applyVisuals then applyVisuals() end
end

	if a.X < 50 or a.Y < 50 then
		local cam = getCamera()
		return cam and cam.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(800, 600)
	end
	return a
end

local function effectiveScale()
	local avail = availSize()
	local auto = 1
	if S.AutoScale then
		auto = math.clamp(math.min(avail.X / 820, avail.Y / 480), 0.7, 1.1)
	end
	return S.UiScale * auto
end

	local vw = UI.window.Size.X.Offset * sc
	local vh = UI.window.Size.Y.Offset * sc

	local x, y

		x, y = UI.window.Position.X.Offset, UI.window.Position.Y.Offset
	else
		x = isTouch and (DOCK_W + 18) or 12
		y = WIN_TOP
	end
	x = math.clamp(x, 0, math.max(avail.X - vw, 0))
	y = math.clamp(y, 0, math.max(avail.Y - vh, 0))

local function selectTab(page)
	local changed = currentPage ~= page
	currentPage = page
	for _, p in pages do
		local active = (p == page)
		if not active then p.frame.Visible = false end
		p.btn.BackgroundColor3 = C_ROW_HI
		p.bar.BackgroundColor3 = ACCENT
		p.icon.TextColor3 = active and ACCENT or C_DIM
		tween(p.btn, { BackgroundTransparency = active and 0 or 1, TextColor3 = active and C_TEXT or C_DIM })

		tween(p.bar, { Size = UDim2.new(0, 3, active and 0.6 or 0, 0) }, TweenInfo.new(0.16, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad))
	end
	page.frame.Visible = true
	if changed and UI.window.Visible then

		page.frame.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 0)
		tween(page.frame, { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0) })
		pcall(function()
			local strip, btn = UI.sidebar, page.btn
			local y = btn.AbsolutePosition.Y - strip.AbsolutePosition.Y + strip.CanvasPosition.Y
			local target = math.max(y - strip.AbsoluteSize.Y / 2 + btn.AbsoluteSize.Y / 2, 0)
			tween(strip, { CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, target) }, TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad))
		end)
	else
		page.frame.Position = UDim2.new()
	end
end

local function getAimPoint()
	local cam = getCamera()
	if isTouch and not hasMouse then
		return cam.ViewportSize / 2
	end
	if not overMenu then
		lastAimPoint = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
	end
	return lastAimPoint
end

local rayParams = RaycastParams.new()
rayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude

local function getTarget(useFov)
	local cam = getCamera()
	if not cam then return nil end

	local point = getAimPoint()
	local camPos = cam.CFrame.Position
	local myChar = player.Character
	rayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = myChar and { myChar } or {}

	local best, bestScore = nil, math.huge
	for _, t in collect(S.IgnoreTeam) do
		local char = t.char
		local hum, part = getHum(char), getAimPart(char)
		if hum and part and hum.Health > 0 then
			local sp, onScreen = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
			local d2 = (Vector2.new(sp.X, sp.Y) - point).Magnitude
			local dist = (part.Position - camPos).Magnitude

			local pass = true
			if useFov then pass = onScreen and d2 <= S.FovRadius end
			if pass and S.WallCheck then
				local hit = workspace:Raycast(camPos, part.Position - camPos, rayParams)
				pass = hit == nil or hit.Instance:IsDescendantOf(char)
			end

			if pass then
				local score
				if S.Priority == 1 then
					score = onScreen and d2 or (1e6 + dist)
				elseif S.Priority == 2 then
					score = dist
				else
					score = hum.Health
				end
				if score < bestScore then
					best, bestScore = t, score
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return best
end

local function teleportNear(tChar, mode)
	local myChar = player.Character
	local myRoot = getRoot(myChar)
	local tRoot = getRoot(tChar)
	if not (isAlive(myChar) and myRoot and tRoot) then return false end

	lastTp = os.clock()

	local offset
	if mode == 1 then
		offset = -tRoot.CFrame.LookVector * S.TpOffset
	elseif mode == 2 then
		offset = tRoot.CFrame.RightVector * S.TpOffset
	else
		offset = Vector3.new(0, S.TpOffset, 0)
	end

	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { myChar, tChar }
	local pos = tRoot.Position + offset
	local hit = workspace:Raycast(tRoot.Position, offset, params)
	if hit then pos = hit.Position + hit.Normal * 2 end

	local cf
	if mode == 1 then
		cf = CFrame.new(pos) * tRoot.CFrame.Rotation
	else
		local look = Vector3.new(tRoot.Position.X, pos.Y, tRoot.Position.Z)
		cf = (look - pos).Magnitude > 0.05 and CFrame.lookAt(pos, look) or CFrame.new(pos)
	end

	markSelf()
	myChar:PivotTo(cf)
	myRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
	return true
end

local function teleportToTarget()
	local t = getTarget(S.TpUseFov)
	if not t then return false end
	return teleportNear(t.char, S.TpMode)
end

local function randomTeleport(char)
	local root = getRoot(char)
	if not root then return end

	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { char }

	local minD = math.min(S.TpDmgMin, S.TpDmgMax)
	local maxD = math.max(S.TpDmgMin, S.TpDmgMax)

	for _ = 1, 8 do
		local angle = math.rad(math.random(0, 359))
		local dist = math.random(minD, maxD)
		local origin = root.Position + Vector3.new(math.cos(angle) * dist, 50, math.sin(angle) * dist)
		local hit = workspace:Raycast(origin, Vector3.new(0, -200, 0), params)
		if hit and hit.Normal.Y > 0.7 then
			markSelf()
			char:PivotTo(CFrame.new(hit.Position + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0)))
			root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
			return
		end
	end
end

local lastDmgTp = 0
local function hookCharacter(char)
	local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10)
	if not hum then return end
	local last = hum.Health
	hum.HealthChanged:Connect(function(new)
		if S.TpDmg and new < last and new > 0 and os.clock() - lastDmgTp >= S.TpDmgCd then
			lastDmgTp = os.clock()
			randomTeleport(char)
		end
		last = new
	end)
end

	end

	local function destroyEsp(char)
		local e = espObjs[char]
		if e then
			e.hl:Destroy()
			e.bb:Destroy()
			espObjs[char] = nil
		end
	end

	updateEsp = function()
		local cam = getCamera()
		if not cam then return end
		if not S.Esp and next(espObjs) == nil then return end

		local camPos = cam.CFrame.Position
		local seen = {}

		if S.Esp then
			for _, t in collect(false) do
				local char, plr = t.char, t.plr
				local hum, root = getHum(char), getRoot(char)
				if hum and root and hum.Health > 0 then
					local dist = (root.Position - camPos).Magnitude
					local hide = (S.EspHideTeam and isTeammate(plr))
						or (S.EspMaxDist < 5000 and dist > S.EspMaxDist)

					if not hide then
						seen[char] = true
						local e = espObjs[char]
						if not e then
							e = createEsp(char)
							espObjs[char] = e
						end

						local frac = math.clamp(hum.Health / math.max(hum.MaxHealth, 1), 0, 1)
						local fillColor = colorOf(S.EspFill)
						local outColor = colorOf(S.EspOutline)
						if S.EspTeamColor and plr and plr.Team then
							fillColor = plr.TeamColor.Color
							outColor = plr.TeamColor.Color
						end
						if S.EspHealthColor then
							fillColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60):Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(60, 255, 90), frac)
						end

						e.hl.Enabled = S.EspHighlight
						e.hl.FillColor = fillColor
						e.hl.OutlineColor = outColor
						e.hl.FillTransparency = S.EspFillTrans
						e.hl.OutlineTransparency = S.EspOutTrans
						e.hl.DepthMode = S.EspAlwaysOnTop
							and Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
							or Enum.HighlightDepthMode.Occluded

						e.bb.Enabled = S.EspNames or S.EspHealth or S.EspDist
						e.bb.Adornee = root

						e.name.Visible = S.EspNames
						e.name.TextSize = S.EspTextSize
						e.name.Text = plr and plr.DisplayName or char.Name

						local parts = {}
						if S.EspHealth then
							parts[#parts + 1] = string.format("%d HP", math.floor(hum.Health + 0.5))
						end
						if S.EspDist then
							parts[#parts + 1] = string.format(tr("%d ст"), math.floor(dist + 0.5))
						end
						e.info.Visible = #parts > 0
						e.info.TextSize = S.EspTextSize - 1
						e.info.Text = table.concat(parts, "  |  ")

						e.bar.Visible = S.EspHealth
						e.fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(frac, 1)
						e.fill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60):Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(60, 255, 90), frac)
					end
				end
			end
		end

		for char in espObjs do
			if not seen[char] then destroyEsp(char) end
		end
	end
end

do
	local coinThread = false

	startCoinLoop = function()
		if coinThread or not S.Coins then return end
		coinThread = true
		task.spawn(function()
			local cache, lastScan = {}, 0
			while S.Coins do
				local char = player.Character
				local root = getRoot(char)
				local pattern = string.lower(S.CoinName)

				if root and isAlive(char) and pattern ~= "" then

					if os.clock() - lastScan > 3 then
						lastScan = os.clock()
						cache = {}
						for _, d in workspace:GetDescendants() do
							if d:IsA("BasePart") and string.find(string.lower(d.Name), pattern, 1, true) then
								local model = d:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
								if not (model and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model)) then
									cache[#cache + 1] = d
								end
							end
						end
					end

					local best, bestDist = nil, S.CoinRange
					for _, coin in cache do
						if coin.Parent then
							local d = (coin.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
							if d <= bestDist then best, bestDist = coin, d end
						end
					end

					if best then
						local origin = root.CFrame
						markSelf(0.6)
						char:PivotTo(CFrame.new(best.Position))
						RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
						if S.CoinReturn and char.Parent then
							markSelf(0.6)
							char:PivotTo(origin)
						end
					end
				end
				task.wait(S.CoinInterval)
			end
			coinThread = false
		end)
	end
end

local function exportConfig()
	local out = {}
	for k, v in DEFAULTS do
		if k ~= "CfgText" and S[k] ~= v and (type(v) == "boolean" or type(v) == "number" or type(v) == "string") then out[k] = S[k] end
	end
	local ok, txt = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONEncode(out) end)
	setValue("CfgText", ok and txt or "", true)
	toast(tr(ok and "Налаштування експортовано в поле нижче" or "Помилка експорту"), ACCENT, true)
end

local function importConfig()
	local ok, data = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(S.CfgText) end)
	if not (ok and type(data) == "table") then
		toast(tr("Невірний формат налаштувань"), Color3.fromRGB(215, 80, 85), true)
		return
	end
	local n = 0
	for k, v in data do
		if k ~= "CfgText" and DEFAULTS[k] ~= nil and type(v) == type(DEFAULTS[k]) then
			setValue(k, v, true)
			n += 1
		end
	end
	toast(string.format(tr("Імпортовано: %d"), n), ACCENT, true)
end

local splashDone = false

local function fadeAll(container, t)
	local info = TweenInfo.new(t, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad)
	local function fade(o)
		if o:IsA("TextLabel") or o:IsA("TextButton") then
			TweenService:Create(o, info, { TextTransparency = 1, BackgroundTransparency = 1 }):Play()
		elseif o:IsA("Frame") then
			TweenService:Create(o, info, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }):Play()
		elseif o:IsA("UIStroke") then
			TweenService:Create(o, info, { Transparency = 1 }):Play()
		end
	end
	fade(container)
	for _, d in container:GetDescendants() do fade(d) end
end

	Z = { "11111", "00001", "00010", "00100", "01000", "10000", "11111" },

}

local function runSplash()
	if splashDone then return end
	splashDone = true
	if not SHOW_INTRO then return end
	splashActive = true

	local gui
	local function cleanup()
		splashActive = false
		local g = gui
		gui = nil
		if g then pcall(function() g:Destroy() end) end
	end

	task.delay(16, cleanup)

	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		local rng = Random.new()
		local qOut = TweenInfo.new(0.8, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)

		gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
		gui.Name = "FunModeIntro"
		gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
		gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
		gui.DisplayOrder = 1000
		gui.Parent = playerGui

		local root = Instance.new("Frame")
		root.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		root.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(6, 7, 10)
		root.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		root.BorderSizePixel = 0
		root.Active = true
		root.Parent = gui
		TweenService:Create(root, TweenInfo.new(0.6), { BackgroundTransparency = 0.04 }):Play()

		local cs = isTouch and 7 or 11
		local gridW = (#PROJECT_NAME * 5 + (#PROJECT_NAME - 1) * 2) * cs
		local gridH = 7 * cs
		local bannerH = gridH + (isTouch and 96 or 118)
		local bannerW = math.max(gridW + cs * 10, 300)

		local banner = Instance.new("Frame")
		banner.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		banner.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.36)
		banner.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(bannerW, bannerH)
		banner.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		banner.Parent = root

		local slats = 9
		for i = 1, slats do
			local s = Instance.new("Frame")
			s.BorderSizePixel = 0
			s.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1 / slats, i < slats and 1 or 0)
			s.Position = UDim2.new(i % 2 == 0 and 1.8 or -1.8, 0, (i - 1) / slats, 0)
			local shade = 16 + (i % 3) * 3
			s.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(shade, shade + 1, shade + 7)
			s.Parent = banner
			task.delay(0.15 + (i - 1) * 0.11, function()
				TweenService:Create(s, qOut, { Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, (i - 1) / slats, 0) }):Play()
			end)
		end

		local function edge(y, delayT)
			local f = Instance.new("Frame")
			f.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
			f.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, y, 0)
			f.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 2)
			f.BackgroundColor3 = ACCENT
			f.BorderSizePixel = 0
			f.Parent = banner
			task.delay(delayT, function()
				TweenService:Create(f, TweenInfo.new(0.7, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
					{ Size = UDim2.new(1.06, 0, 0, 2) }):Play()
			end)
			return f
		end
		edge(0, 1.5)
		edge(1, 1.6)

		local progress = Instance.new("Frame")
		progress.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1)
		progress.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -6)
		progress.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 1)
		progress.BackgroundColor3 = ACCENT
		progress.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3
		progress.BorderSizePixel = 0
		progress.Parent = banner

		local grid = Instance.new("Frame")
		grid.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
		grid.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, isTouch and 26 or 32)
		grid.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(gridW, gridH)
		grid.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		grid.Parent = banner

		local cells = {}
		local charset = PROJECT_NAME
		local n = 0
		for li = 1, #PROJECT_NAME do
			local g = GLYPHS[string.sub(PROJECT_NAME, li, li)]
			if g then
				local ox = (li - 1) * 7 * cs
				for r = 1, 7 do
					for c = 1, 5 do
						if string.sub(g[r], c, c) == "1" then
							n += 1
							local l = Instance.new("TextLabel")
							l.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(cs, cs)
							local fx, fy = ox + (c - 1) * cs, (r - 1) * cs
							l.BackgroundTransparency = 1
							l.Text = string.sub(charset, (n - 1) % #charset + 1, (n - 1) % #charset + 1)
							l.TextColor3 = ACCENT
							l.Font = FONT_MONO
							l.TextSize = cs + 1
							l.TextTransparency = 1
							l.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(fx + rng:NextInteger(-260, 260), fy + rng:NextInteger(-170, 170))
							l.Rotation = rng:NextInteger(-90, 90)
							l.Parent = grid
							cells[#cells + 1] = { l = l, x = fx, y = fy }
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end

		local assembleFrom, assembleSpan = 2.0, 3.6
		for _, cell in cells do
			local d = assembleFrom + rng:NextNumber() * assembleSpan
			task.delay(d, function()
				TweenService:Create(cell.l, TweenInfo.new(0.7, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
					{ Position = UDim2.fromOffset(cell.x, cell.y), Rotation = 0, TextTransparency = 0 }):Play()

		btnRow.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40)

local function flyUpdate(char, root, hum, dt)
		if S.Fly then
			local cam = getCamera()
			local move = hum.MoveDirection
			local dir = Vector3.zero
			if cam and move.Magnitude > 0.01 then
				dir = move
				if S.FlyPitch then
					local look = cam.CFrame.LookVector
					local flat = Vector3.new(look.X, 0, look.Z)
					local fwd = flat.Magnitude > 0.01 and move:Dot(flat.Unit) or 0
					dir += Vector3.new(0, look.Y * fwd, 0)
				end
			end
			if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) or (isTouch and hum.Jump) then
				dir += Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
			end
			if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift)
				or UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl) then
				dir -= Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
			end
			dir = Vector3.new(dir.X, dir.Y * S.FlyVert / 100, dir.Z)
			local moving = dir.Magnitude > 0.05
			if moving and dir.Magnitude > 1 then dir = dir.Unit end

			if moving or S.FlyHold then root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero end
			flyOn = true
			markSelf(0.6)

			local ramp = 1
			if S.FlyRamp then
				flyRampT = moving and math.min(flyRampT + dt, S.FlyRampTime) or 0
				ramp = 0.2 + 0.8 * flyRampT / math.max(S.FlyRampTime, 0.05)
			else
				flyRampT = 0
			end
			local step = S.FlyStep * ramp
			local tick = math.max(S.FlyTickMs / 1000, step / math.max(S.FlyMaxSps, 1))

			local function advance(dist)
				local delta = dir * dist
				if S.FlyWalls and not S.Noclip then
					flyRp.FilterDescendantsInstances = { char }
					local r = workspace:Raycast(root.Position, dir.Unit * (dist + 2), flyRp)
					if r then delta = dir.Unit * math.max(r.Distance - 2, 0) end
				end
				if delta.Magnitude > 0.01 then
					root.CFrame = root.CFrame + delta
					root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
				end
			end

			local mode = S.FlyMode
			if moving and (mode == 2 or mode == 3) then
				local sps = math.min(step / tick, S.FlyMaxSps)
				root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = dir * (mode == 3 and sps * 0.5 or sps)
			end
			if moving and mode ~= 2 then
				if S.FlySmooth then
					flyAcc = 0
					advance(step * math.min(dt / tick, 1))
				else
					flyAcc += dt
					if flyAcc >= tick then
						flyAcc = 0
						advance(step)
					end
				end
			else
				flyAcc = tick
			end
		elseif flyOn then
			flyOn = false
			root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, math.min(root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y, 0), 0)
			markSelf(1.5)
		end
end

local flyErrShown = false
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
	local char = player.Character
	local root, hum = getRoot(char), getHum(char)

	if (S.IncludeNPCs or S.EspNPC) and os.clock() - lastNpcScan > 2 then
		lastNpcScan = os.clock()
		scanNPCs()
	end

	if root and hum then

		if S.SpeedOn then
			if orig.walk == nil then orig.walk = hum.WalkSpeed end
			hum.WalkSpeed = S.Speed
		elseif orig.walk ~= nil then
			hum.WalkSpeed = orig.walk
			orig.walk = nil
		end

		if S.JumpOn then
			if orig.jump == nil then
				orig.jump = hum.JumpPower
				orig.useJP = hum.UseJumpPower
			end
			hum.UseJumpPower = true
			hum.JumpPower = S.JumpPower
		elseif orig.jump ~= nil then
			hum.UseJumpPower = orig.useJP
			hum.JumpPower = orig.jump
			orig.jump = nil
		end

		if S.TpAuto and os.clock() - lastTp >= S.TpInterval and os.clock() - lastTpTry >= 0.1 then
			lastTpTry = os.clock()
			teleportToTarget()
		end

		do
			local okF, errF = pcall(flyUpdate, char, root, hum, dt)
			if not okF and not flyErrShown then
				flyErrShown = true
				warn("[ZENITH] fly: " .. tostring(errF))
				pcall(toast, "Fly: " .. tostring(errF), Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 90), true, 8)
			end
		end

		if S.Bhop and not S.Fly then
			local now = os.clock()
			local v = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
			local move = hum.MoveDirection
			local keyHeld = UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space)
			local touchHeld = isTouch and hum.Jump and now - bhopSet > 0.15
			local held = keyHeld or touchHeld
			local grounded = hum.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air
			local seated = hum.SeatPart ~= nil or hum.Sit
			if held and not seated and hum.Health > 0 then
				if grounded then
					local carry = bhopHV
					if move.Magnitude < 0.01 then carry = Vector3.zero end
					local jp = hum.UseJumpPower and hum.JumpPower or math.sqrt(2 * workspace.Gravity * hum.JumpHeight)
					local hv = Vector3.new(v.X, 0, v.Z)
					if carry.Magnitude > hv.Magnitude then hv = carry end
					root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(hv.X, jp, hv.Z)
					hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
					bhopSet = now
					markSelf(0.6)
				elseif move.Magnitude > 0.01 then
					local wish = Vector3.new(move.X, 0, move.Z).Unit
					local hv = Vector3.new(v.X, 0, v.Z)
					local addSpeed = 12 - hv:Dot(wish)
					if addSpeed > 0 then
						hv += wish * math.min(addSpeed, S.BhopGain * 120 * dt)
					end
					if hv.Magnitude > S.BhopMax then hv = hv.Unit * S.BhopMax end
					root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(hv.X, v.Y, hv.Z)
					bhopHV = hv
					markSelf(0.6)
				else
					bhopHV = Vector3.new(v.X, 0, v.Z)
				end
			else
				bhopHV = Vector3.zero
			end
		end

		if S.Spin then
			hum.AutoRotate = false
			spinOn = true
			local pos = root.Position
			if S.SpinMode == 1 then
				spinAngle = (spinAngle + S.SpinSpeed * dt) % 360
				root.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(spinAngle), 0)
			elseif S.SpinMode == 2 then
				root.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(math.random(0, 359)), 0)
			else
				local cam = getCamera()
				local look = cam and cam.CFrame.LookVector or Vector3.zAxis
				local flat = Vector3.new(look.X, 0, look.Z)
				if flat.Magnitude > 0.01 then
					root.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(pos, pos - flat)
				end
			end
		elseif spinOn then
			hum.AutoRotate = true
			spinOn = false
		end
	end

	espTimer += dt
	if espTimer >= 0.1 then
		espTimer = 0
		updateEsp()
		if S.Debug then updateFooter() end
	end
end)
