safeRun("drones", function()
	local DRONE_TAG = "Drone"
	local MAX_DRONE_SIZE = 60

	local TRANSLIT = {
		[0x430] = "a", [0x431] = "b", [0x432] = "v", [0x433] = "g", [0x491] = "g",
		[0x434] = "d", [0x435] = "e", [0x454] = "e", [0x451] = "e", [0x436] = "zh",
		[0x437] = "z", [0x438] = "i", [0x456] = "i", [0x457] = "i", [0x439] = "y",
		[0x43A] = "k", [0x43B] = "l", [0x43C] = "m", [0x43D] = "n", [0x43E] = "o",
		[0x43F] = "p", [0x440] = "r", [0x441] = "s", [0x442] = "t", [0x443] = "u",
		[0x444] = "f", [0x445] = "kh", [0x446] = "ts", [0x447] = "ch", [0x448] = "sh",
		[0x449] = "shch", [0x44A] = "", [0x44B] = "y", [0x44C] = "", [0x44D] = "e",
		[0x44E] = "yu", [0x44F] = "ya",
	}
	local LEET = { ["0"] = "o", ["1"] = "i", ["3"] = "e", ["4"] = "a", ["5"] = "s", ["7"] = "t", ["@"] = "a", ["$"] = "s" }
	local foldCache = {}

	local function fold(s)
		local cached = foldCache[s]
		if cached then return cached end

		local out = {}
		local ok = pcall(function()
			for _, cp in utf8.codes(s) do
				local c = cp
				if c >= 0x410 and c <= 0x42F then c += 32
				elseif c >= 0x400 and c <= 0x40F then c += 80
				elseif c == 0x490 then c = 0x491 end

				if c < 128 then
					local ch = string.lower(string.char(c))
					ch = LEET[ch] or ch
					if string.find(ch, "^%w+$") then out[#out + 1] = ch end
				elseif TRANSLIT[c] then
					out[#out + 1] = TRANSLIT[c]
				end
			end
		end)

		local result
		if ok then
			result = table.concat(out)
		else
			result = string.gsub(string.lower(s), "[^%w]", "")
		end
		foldCache[s] = result
		return result
	end

	local function parseList(text)
		local list = {}
		for token in string.gmatch(tostring(text), "[^,;\n]+") do
			local f = fold(token)
			if #f >= 3 then list[#list + 1] = f end
		end
		return list
	end

	local function matches(name, include, exclude)
		local f = fold(name)
		for _, ex in exclude do
			if string.find(f, ex, 1, true) then return false end
		end
		for _, inc in include do
			if string.find(f, inc, 1, true) then return true end
		end
		return false
	end

	local droneCache, enemyList = {}, {}
	local scanning, lastScan, forceScan = false, 0, true
	local lastEnemy = 0
	local lastNameKey = ""

	local function inAnyCharacter(inst)
		for _, plr in Players:GetPlayers() do
			local c = plr.Character
			if c and inst:IsDescendantOf(c) then return true end
		end
		return false
	end

	local function rescan()
		if scanning then return end
		scanning = true
		lastScan = os.clock()
		forceScan = false

		task.spawn(function()
			local include, exclude = parseList(S.DrName), parseList(S.DrExclude)
			local found, set, sizeCache = {}, {}, {}

			local function sizeOf(inst)
				local s = sizeCache[inst]
				if s then return s end
				if inst:IsA("Model") then
					s = inst:GetExtentsSize().Magnitude
				else
					s = inst.Size.Magnitude
				end
				sizeCache[inst] = s
				return s
			end

			local function consider(inst, checkSize)
				if not inst or not inst.Parent or set[inst] then return end
				if inAnyCharacter(inst) then return end

				local target = inst
				if inst:IsA("BasePart") then
					target = inst:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model") or inst
				end
				if checkSize and sizeOf(target) > MAX_DRONE_SIZE then

					if inst:IsA("BasePart") and target ~= inst and sizeOf(inst) <= MAX_DRONE_SIZE then
						target = inst
					else
						return
					end
				end
				if not set[target] then
					set[target] = true
					found[#found + 1] = target
				end
			end

			for _, inst in CollectionService:GetTagged(DRONE_TAG) do
				consider(inst, false)
			end

			if #include > 0 then
				local n = 0
				for _, inst in workspace:GetDescendants() do
					n += 1
					if n % 3000 == 0 then task.wait() end
					if inst.Parent and (inst:IsA("Model") or inst:IsA("BasePart")) then
						if matches(inst.Name, include, exclude) then
							consider(inst, true)
						end
					end
				end
			end

			local out = {}
			for _, m in found do
				local nested = false
				local p = m.Parent
				while p and p ~= workspace do
					if set[p] then nested = true break end
					p = p.Parent
				end
				if not nested then out[#out + 1] = m end
			end

			droneCache = out
			scanning = false
		end)
	end

	local function dronePos(m)
		if m:IsA("Model") then return m:GetPivot().Position end
		return m.Position
	end

	local function dronePart(m)
		if m:IsA("BasePart") then return m end
		return m.PrimaryPart or m:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
	end

	local function rebuildEnemies()
		local out = {}
		for _, m in droneCache do
			if m.Parent then
				local own, team = false, false
				local uid = m:GetAttribute("OwnerUserId")
				if uid == player.UserId then own = true end

				local ownerPlr = uid and Players:GetPlayerByUserId(uid)
				if not ownerPlr then
					for _, plr in Players:GetPlayers() do
						if string.find(m.Name, plr.Name, 1, true) then
							ownerPlr = plr
							break
						end
					end
				end
				if ownerPlr == player then own = true end
				if ownerPlr and isTeammate(ownerPlr) then team = true end

				if not own and not team then out[#out + 1] = m end
			end
		end
		enemyList = out
	end

	droneReport = function()
		forceScan = true
		rescan()
		task.spawn(function()
			while scanning do task.wait(0.05) end
			rebuildEnemies()
			toast(string.format(tr("Дронів знайдено: %d (ворожих: %d)"), #droneCache, #enemyList), ACCENT, true)
		end)
	end

	local espFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
	espFolder.Name = "FunModeDroneESP"
	espFolder.Parent = playerGui
	local dEsp = {}

	local function clearEsp()
		for m, e in dEsp do
			e.hl:Destroy()
			e.bb:Destroy()
			dEsp[m] = nil
		end
	end

	local function updateDroneEsp(rootPos)
		if not S.DrEsp then clearEsp() return end
		local seen = {}
		for _, m in enemyList do
			seen[m] = true
			local e = dEsp[m]
			if not e then
				local part = dronePart(m)
				if part then
					local hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
					hl.Adornee = m
					hl.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
					hl.FillTransparency = 0.5
					hl.Parent = espFolder

					local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
					bb.Adornee = part
					bb.AlwaysOnTop = true
					bb.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(140, 18)
					bb.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0)
					bb.Parent = espFolder

					local t = Instance.new("TextLabel")
					t.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
					t.BackgroundTransparency = 1
					t.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
					t.TextSize = 13
					t.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.4
					t.Parent = bb

					e = { hl = hl, bb = bb, text = t }
					dEsp[m] = e
				end
			end
			if e then
				local c = colorOf(S.DrEspColor)
				e.hl.FillColor, e.hl.OutlineColor = c, c
				e.text.TextColor3 = c
				e.text.Text = string.format(tr("ДРОН %d ст"), math.floor((dronePos(m) - rootPos).Magnitude))
			end
		end
		for m, e in dEsp do
			if not seen[m] then
				e.hl:Destroy()
				e.bb:Destroy()
				dEsp[m] = nil
			end
		end
	end

	local warnLabel = makeText(UI.gui, UDim2.fromOffset(320, 28), UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.16, 0),
		"", 18, Color3.fromRGB(255, 70, 70), FONT_B, Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, true)
	warnLabel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
	warnLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.4
	warnLabel.Visible = false

	local vig = Instance.new("Frame")
	vig.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	vig.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	vig.Active = false
	vig.Parent = UI.overlay
	local vigStroke = addStroke(vig, Color3.fromRGB(255, 40, 40), 14, 1)

	local espTimer2, lastEvade, lastFire = 0, 0, 0

	RunService:BindToRenderStep("FunModeDrones", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 2, function(dt)
		local anyOn = S.DrEsp or S.DrWarn or S.DrAim or S.DrAutoFire or S.DrEvade
		local cam = getCamera()
		local char = player.Character
		local root = getRoot(char)

		if not (anyOn and gateOpen and cam and root) then
			warnLabel.Visible = false
			vigStroke.Transparency = 1
			clearEsp()
			return
		end

		local nameKey = S.DrName .. "|" .. S.DrExclude
		if nameKey ~= lastNameKey then
			lastNameKey = nameKey
			forceScan = true
		end
		if (forceScan or os.clock() - lastScan > 4) and not scanning then
			rescan()
		end
		if os.clock() - lastEnemy > 0.25 then
			lastEnemy = os.clock()
			rebuildEnemies()
		end

		local camPos = cam.CFrame.Position

		local nearest, nearestDist
		for _, m in enemyList do
			if m.Parent then
				local d = (dronePos(m) - root.Position).Magnitude
				if not nearestDist or d < nearestDist then nearest, nearestDist = m, d end
			end
		end

		espTimer2 += dt
		if espTimer2 >= 0.1 then
			espTimer2 = 0
			updateDroneEsp(root.Position)
		end

		if S.DrWarn and nearest and nearestDist <= S.DrWarnRadius then
			warnLabel.Text = string.format(tr("ДРОН %s %d ст"), arrowFor(cam, dronePos(nearest)), math.floor(nearestDist))
			warnLabel.Visible = true
			vigStroke.Transparency = 0.55 + 0.35 * math.sin(os.clock() * 10)
		else
			warnLabel.Visible = false
			vigStroke.Transparency = 1
		end

		local aimActive = S.DrAim and (not S.AimHold or not hasMouse or aimHeld)
		if aimActive or S.DrAutoFire then
			local point = getAimPoint()
			local bestPos, bestScore
			for _, m in enemyList do
				if m.Parent then
					local pos = dronePos(m)
					if (pos - camPos).Magnitude <= S.DrAimRange then
						local sp, onScreen = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(pos)
						if onScreen then
							local d2 = (Vector2.new(sp.X, sp.Y) - point).Magnitude
							if not bestScore or d2 < bestScore then
								bestPos, bestScore = pos, d2
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end

			if bestPos then
				if aimActive then
					cam.CFrame = cam.CFrame:Lerp(CFrame.lookAt(camPos, bestPos), math.max(S.Smooth, 0.35))
				end
				if S.DrAutoFire and os.clock() - lastFire > 0.12 then
					local dir = (bestPos - camPos).Unit
					if dir:Dot(cam.CFrame.LookVector) > 0.9962 then
						local tool = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
						if tool then
							lastFire = os.clock()
							tool:Activate()
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end

		if S.DrEvade and nearest and nearestDist <= S.DrEvadeRadius
			and os.clock() - lastEvade >= S.DrEvadeCd and isAlive(char) then
			lastEvade = os.clock()
			local dpos = dronePos(nearest)
			local away = Vector3.new(root.Position.X - dpos.X, 0, root.Position.Z - dpos.Z)
			away = away.Magnitude > 0.1 and away.Unit or Vector3.new(1, 0, 0)

			local params = RaycastParams.new()
			params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
			params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { char }

			for _ = 1, 8 do
				local dir = CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(math.random(-60, 60)), 0) * away
				local origin = root.Position + dir * S.DrEvadeDist + Vector3.new(0, 40, 0)
				local hit = workspace:Raycast(origin, Vector3.new(0, -150, 0), params)
				if hit and hit.Normal.Y > 0.7 then
					markSelf()
					char:PivotTo(CFrame.new(hit.Position + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0)))
					root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
					break
				end
			end
		end
	end)
end)

safeRun("anti-fling", function()
	local afSaved = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
	local afParts = {}
	local afRefresh = 0
	local flagged = {}
	local lastGood, lastGround = nil, nil
	local lastHum, lastBlock = nil, nil
	local scanT = 0
	local lastNC = nil

	local function refreshParts()
		afRefresh = os.clock()
		local fresh = {}
		for _, plr in Players:GetPlayers() do
			if isPulled(plr.Character) then continue end
			local char = plr.Character
			if plr ~= player and char then
				local parts = {}
				for _, d in char:GetDescendants() do
					if d:IsA("BasePart") then parts[#parts + 1] = d end
				end
				local old = afParts[char]
				fresh[char] = { plr = plr, parts = parts, on = old and old.on or false }
			end
		end
		afParts = fresh
	end

	local function restoreCollisions()
		for part in afSaved do
			if part.Parent then part.CanCollide = true end
			afSaved[part] = nil
		end
	end

	RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
		local on = S.AntiFling and gateOpen
		local nc = on and S.AfNoCollide

		if lastNC ~= nc then
			lastNC = nc
			restoreCollisions()
			for _, e in afParts do e.on = false end
		end
		if not on then return end

		local now = os.clock()
		if now - afRefresh > 1 then refreshParts() end

		local myRoot = getRoot(player.Character)
		local myPos = myRoot and myRoot.Position

		for char, e in afParts do
			local r = getRoot(char)
			local near = myPos ~= nil and r ~= nil and (r.Position - myPos).Magnitude < 80

			local apply = char.Parent ~= nil and near and (nc or (flagged[e.plr] or 0) > now)
			if apply or e.on then
				for _, part in e.parts do
					if part.Parent then
						if apply then
							if part.CanCollide then
								afSaved[part] = true
								part.CanCollide = false
							end
						elseif afSaved[part] then
							part.CanCollide = true
							afSaved[part] = nil
						end
					end
				end
				e.on = apply and true or false
			end
		end
	end)

	local function applyStates(hum, block)
		pcall(function()
			hum:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown, not block)
			hum:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll, not block)
		end)
	end

	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
		local on = S.AntiFling and gateOpen

		if not on then
			if lastHum and lastBlock then applyStates(lastHum, false) end
			lastHum, lastBlock = nil, nil
			lastGood, lastGround = nil, nil
			return
		end

		local char = player.Character
		local root, hum = getRoot(char), getHum(char)
		if not (root and hum and hum.Health > 0) then
			lastGood, lastGround = nil, nil
			return
		end

		local wantBlock = S.AfNoRagdoll
		if lastHum ~= hum or lastBlock ~= wantBlock then
			if lastHum and lastHum ~= hum and lastBlock then applyStates(lastHum, false) end
			applyStates(hum, wantBlock)
			lastHum, lastBlock = hum, wantBlock
		end
		if wantBlock then
			local st = hum:GetState()
			if st == Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown or st == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll then
				hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp)
			end
		end

		local seated = hum.SeatPart ~= nil
		local vel = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
		local horiz = Vector3.new(vel.X, 0, vel.Z).Magnitude
		local up = math.max(vel.Y, 0)

		local limit = S.AfSpeed
		if S.Fly then limit = math.max(limit, S.FlyMaxSps * 2.5) end
		if S.Bhop then limit = math.max(limit, S.BhopMax * 3) end
		if S.SpeedOn then limit = math.max(limit, S.Speed * 3) end
		if S.JumpOn then limit = math.max(limit, S.JumpPower * 3) end

		local angBad = root.AssemblyAngularVelocity.Magnitude > S.AfAng and not S.Spin
		local bad = S.AfClamp and not seated and (math.max(horiz, up) > limit or angBad)

		if bad then
			root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
			root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
			if lastGood then root.CFrame = lastGood end
			defNote("fling", S.AfNotify, "Антифлінг: удар погашено", Color3.fromRGB(255, 160, 80), 2)
		elseif not seated then
			lastGood = root.CFrame
			if hum.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air then
				lastGround = root.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)
			end
		else
			lastGood = nil
		end

		if S.AfVoid and lastGround then
			local floorY = workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight + 80
			if root.Position.Y < floorY then
				markSelf(0.5)
				root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
				root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
				char:PivotTo(lastGround)
				defNote("void", S.AfNotify, "Антифлінг: повернено з прірви", Color3.fromRGB(255, 160, 80), 2)
			end
		end

		scanT += dt
		if scanT >= 0.1 then
			scanT = 0
			local now = os.clock()
			for _, plr in Players:GetPlayers() do
				if plr ~= player then
					local r = getRoot(plr.Character)
					if r then
						local ang = r.AssemblyAngularVelocity.Magnitude
						local lin = r.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude
						if ang > S.AfAng * 1.5 or lin > S.AfSpeed * 2 then
							if (flagged[plr] or 0) < now then
								defNote("fl_" .. plr.UserId, S.AfNotify, "Підозра на fling: %s",
									Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 80), 4, plr.DisplayName)
							end
							flagged[plr] = now + 6
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end)

	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(plr) flagged[plr] = nil end)
end)

safeRun("defense", function()
	local defFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
	defFolder.Name = "FunModeDefense"
	defFolder.Parent = playerGui

	local localFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
	localFolder.Name = "FunModeLocal"
	localFolder.Parent = workspace

	local function topLabel(y, color)
		local l = makeText(UI.gui, UDim2.fromOffset(380, 24), UDim2.new(0.5, 0, y, 0), "", 16, color, FONT_B,
			Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, true)
		l.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
		l.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.4
		l.Visible = false
		return l
	end
	local awLabel = topLabel(0.21, Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80))
	local tpLabel = topLabel(0.26, Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 80))

	local track = {}
	local jumpHooks = {}
	local function onEnemyJump(fn) jumpHooks[#jumpHooks + 1] = fn end

	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
		if not gateOpen or not (S.Counter or S.TpHl) then
			if next(track) ~= nil then table.clear(track) end
			return
		end
		local now = os.clock()
		local base = math.max(15, dt * 250)

		for _, plr in Players:GetPlayers() do
			if isPulled(plr.Character) then continue end
			if plr ~= player then
				local char = plr.Character
				local root = getRoot(char)
				local rec = track[plr]

				if not (root and isAlive(char)) then
					track[plr] = nil
				elseif not rec or rec.root ~= root then
					track[plr] = { root = root, pos = root.Position, born = now }
				else
					local pos = root.Position
					local from = rec.pos
					local jump = (pos - from).Magnitude
					rec.pos = pos
					if jump >= base and now - rec.born > 1 then
						for _, fn in jumpHooks do fn(plr, char, from, pos, jump) end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end)

	local enemyCd, lastCounter = {}, 0
	local faceChar, faceUntil = nil, 0

	local function trigger(plr, char)
		local now = os.clock()
		if now - lastCounter < S.CtCooldown then return end
		if now - (enemyCd[plr] or 0) < S.CtCooldown * 2 then return end
		lastCounter, enemyCd[plr] = now, now

		local name = plr.DisplayName
		if S.CtMode == 3 then
			toast(string.format(tr("До вас тепнувся: %s"), name), Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 80), true)
			return
		end

		task.delay(S.CtDelay, function()
			if not (gateOpen and S.Counter) then return end
			if not (isAlive(char) and isAlive(player.Character)) then return end

			if S.CtMode == 1 then
				if teleportNear(char, 1) then
					toast(string.format(tr("Контр-ТП: %s"), name), ACCENT, true)
				end
			else
				toast(string.format(tr("Розворот на: %s"), name), ACCENT, true)
			end
			if S.CtFace then
				faceChar, faceUntil = char, os.clock() + 0.35
			end
		end)
	end

	onEnemyJump(function(plr, char, from, pos, jump)
		if not (S.Counter and gateOpen) or jump < S.CtMinJump or isTeammate(plr) then return end
		local myChar = player.Character
		local myRoot = getRoot(myChar)
		if not (myRoot and isAlive(myChar)) then return end

		local myPos = myRoot.Position
		if (pos - myPos).Magnitude > S.CtRadius or (from - myPos).Magnitude <= S.CtRadius then return end

		if S.CtBehindOnly then
			local cam = getCamera()
			local look = cam and cam.CFrame.LookVector or myRoot.CFrame.LookVector
			local lookFlat = Vector3.new(look.X, 0, look.Z)
			local flat = Vector3.new(pos.X - myPos.X, 0, pos.Z - myPos.Z)
			if flat.Magnitude > 0.1 and lookFlat.Magnitude > 0.1 and lookFlat.Unit:Dot(flat.Unit) >= -0.2 then
				return
			end
		end
		trigger(plr, char)
	end)

	RunService:BindToRenderStep("FunModeCounter", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 3, function()
		if faceChar and os.clock() < faceUntil then
			local cam = getCamera()
			local part = faceChar:FindFirstChild("Head") or getRoot(faceChar)
			if cam and part then
				cam.CFrame = cam.CFrame:Lerp(CFrame.lookAt(cam.CFrame.Position, part.Position), 0.55)
			end
		elseif faceChar then
			faceChar = nil
		end
	end)

	local markers = {}
	local tpLabelPlr, tpLabelUntil = nil, 0

	local function clearMarker(plr)
		local m = markers[plr]
		if m then
			for _, o in m.objs do
				if o.Parent then o:Destroy() end
			end
			markers[plr] = nil
		end
	end

	local function showTpMarker(plr, char, pos)
		clearMarker(plr)
		local color = colorOf(S.TpHlColor)
		local objs = {}

		local anchor = Instance.new("Part")
		anchor.Anchored = true
		anchor.CanCollide, anchor.CanQuery, anchor.CanTouch = false, false, false
		anchor.Transparency = 1
		anchor.Size = Vector3.one
		anchor.Position = pos + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0)
		anchor.Parent = localFolder
		objs[#objs + 1] = anchor

		local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
		bb.Adornee = anchor
		bb.AlwaysOnTop = true
		bb.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(170, 36)
		bb.MaxDistance = 1e5
		bb.Parent = defFolder
		objs[#objs + 1] = bb

		local l1 = makeText(bb, UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 18), UDim2.new(), "" .. plr.DisplayName, 14, color, FONT_B,
			Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, true)
		l1.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.3
		local l2 = makeText(bb, UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 16), UDim2.fromOffset(0, 18), "", 13, C_TEXT, FONT_B,
			Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, true)
		l2.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.3

		local ring = Instance.new("Part")
		ring.Anchored = true
		ring.CanCollide, ring.CanQuery, ring.CanTouch = false, false, false
		ring.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
		ring.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
		ring.Color = color
		ring.Transparency = 0.25
		ring.Size = Vector3.new(0.2, 2, 2)
		ring.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos - Vector3.new(0, 2.8, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90))
		ring.Parent = localFolder
		objs[#objs + 1] = ring
		TweenService:Create(ring, TweenInfo.new(1.1, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
			{ Size = Vector3.new(0.2, 22, 22), Transparency = 1 }):Play()

		local hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
		hl.Adornee = char
		hl.FillColor, hl.OutlineColor = color, color
		hl.FillTransparency = 0.55
		hl.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
		hl.Parent = defFolder
		objs[#objs + 1] = hl

		markers[plr] = { objs = objs, char = char, born = os.clock(), life = S.TpHlTime, l2 = l2 }
		tpLabelPlr, tpLabelUntil = plr, os.clock() + math.min(S.TpHlTime, 2.5)
		tpLabel.TextColor3 = color
	end

	onEnemyJump(function(plr, char, from, pos, jump)
		if not (S.TpHl and gateOpen) or jump < S.TpHlMin then return end
		if isTeammate(plr) and not S.TpHlTeam then return end
		local myRoot = getRoot(player.Character)
		local dist = myRoot and (pos - myRoot.Position).Magnitude or 0
		if dist > S.TpHlRange then return end
		showTpMarker(plr, char, pos)
	end)

	local function updateMarkers()
		local now = os.clock()
		local cam = getCamera()
		local myRoot = getRoot(player.Character)

		for plr, m in markers do
			if not S.TpHl or not gateOpen or now - m.born > m.life or not m.char.Parent then
				clearMarker(plr)
			else
				local r = getRoot(m.char)
				local d = (myRoot and r) and (r.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude or 0
				m.l2.Text = string.format(tr("%d ст"), math.floor(d))
			end
		end

		local shown = false
		if S.TpHl and gateOpen and tpLabelPlr and now < tpLabelUntil and cam and myRoot then
			local r = getRoot(tpLabelPlr.Character)
			if r then
				tpLabel.Text = string.format(tr("ТП: %s %s %d ст"), tpLabelPlr.DisplayName,
					arrowFor(cam, r.Position), math.floor((r.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude))
				shown = true
			end
		end
		tpLabel.Visible = shown
	end

	local awRec = {}
	local awParams = RaycastParams.new()
	awParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	local awLast = 0

	local function scanAim()
		local now = os.clock()
		local myChar = player.Character
		local myRoot = getRoot(myChar)
		if not (myRoot and isAlive(myChar)) then
			table.clear(awRec)
			return nil
		end

		local target = myRoot.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0)
		local best, bestSince

		for _, plr in Players:GetPlayers() do
			if isPulled(plr.Character) then continue end
			if plr ~= player and (S.AwTeam or not isTeammate(plr)) then
				local char = plr.Character
				local head = char and char:FindFirstChild("Head")
				local root = getRoot(char)
				if root and isAlive(char) then
					local part = head or root
					local origin = part.Position
					local look = part.CFrame.LookVector
					local to = target - origin
					local dist = to.Magnitude
					local hit = false

					if dist >= 3 and dist <= S.AwRange then
						local allowed = math.max(S.AwAngle, math.deg(math.atan(1.5 / dist)))
						local ang = math.deg(math.acos(math.clamp(look:Dot(to / dist), -1, 1)))
						hit = ang <= allowed
						if hit and S.AwWall then
							awParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { char, myChar }
							hit = workspace:Raycast(origin, to, awParams) == nil
						end
					end

					local rec = awRec[plr]
					if hit then
						if not rec then
							rec = { since = now, last = now }
							awRec[plr] = rec
						end
						rec.last = now
						if now - rec.since >= S.AwTime and (not bestSince or rec.since < bestSince) then
							best, bestSince = { plr = plr, pos = origin, dist = dist }, rec.since
						end
					elseif rec and now - rec.last > 0.25 then
						awRec[plr] = nil
					end
				else
					awRec[plr] = nil
				end
			end
		end
		return best
	end

	local function updateAimWarn()
		local best = (S.AimWarn and gateOpen) and scanAim() or nil
		local cam = getCamera()
		if best and cam then
			awLabel.Text = string.format(tr("ПРИЦІЛ НА ВАС: %s %s %d ст"), best.plr.DisplayName,
				arrowFor(cam, best.pos), math.floor(best.dist))
			awLabel.TextTransparency = 0.05 + 0.3 * (0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(os.clock() * 12))
			awLabel.Visible = true
			awLast = os.clock()
		elseif os.clock() - awLast > 0.3 then
			awLabel.Visible = false
		end
	end

	local suspRec = {}

	local function lookOf(char)
		local h = char:FindFirstChild("Head") or getRoot(char)
		return h, h and h.CFrame.LookVector
	end

	local function snappedOnTarget(plr, origin, prevLook, curLook)
		for _, other in Players:GetPlayers() do
			if other ~= plr then
				local oc = other.Character
				local part = oc and (oc:FindFirstChild("Head") or getRoot(oc))
				if part and isAlive(oc) then
					local to = part.Position - origin
					local d = to.Magnitude
					if d >= 5 and d <= 700 then
						local dir = to / d
						local err = math.deg(math.acos(math.clamp(curLook:Dot(dir), -1, 1)))
						if err <= 2.5 then
							local prevErr = math.deg(math.acos(math.clamp(prevLook:Dot(dir), -1, 1)))
							if prevErr >= 25 then return true end
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
		return false
	end

	local function removeTag(rec)
		if rec.tag then
			rec.tag:Destroy()
			rec.tag = nil
		end
	end

	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		if not (gateOpen and S.Susp) then return end
		local now = os.clock()
		for _, plr in Players:GetPlayers() do
			if isPulled(plr.Character) then continue end
			if plr ~= player then
				local char = plr.Character
				local head, look
				if char then head, look = lookOf(char) end
				if char and head and look and isAlive(char) then
					local rec = suspRec[plr]
					if not rec then
						rec = { score = 0, lastEvent = 0, decayT = now }
						suspRec[plr] = rec
					end
					if rec.look and rec.head == head then
						local ang = math.deg(math.acos(math.clamp(rec.look:Dot(look), -1, 1)))
						if ang >= S.SuspSnap and now - rec.lastEvent > 0.5
							and snappedOnTarget(plr, head.Position, rec.look, look) then
							rec.score += 1
							rec.lastEvent, rec.decayT = now, now
							if rec.score >= S.SuspThreshold and not rec.notified then
								rec.notified = true
								defNote("susp_" .. plr.UserId, S.SuspNotify, "Підозра на аімбот: %s",
									Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 90), 15, plr.DisplayName)
							end
						end
					end
					rec.look, rec.head = look, head
				end
			end
		end
	end)

	refreshSuspInfo = function()
		if not suspInfoLabel then return end
		local list = {}
		for plr, rec in suspRec do
			if rec.score > 0 then
				list[#list + 1] = { name = plr.DisplayName, score = rec.score, flagged = rec.score >= S.SuspThreshold }
			end
		end
		table.sort(list, function(a, b) return a.score > b.score end)

		local lines = {}
		for i = 1, math.min(#list, 5) do
			local e = list[i]
			lines[#lines + 1] = string.format("%s%s  ×%d", e.flagged and "! " or "   ", e.name, e.score)
		end
		suspInfoLabel.Text = tr("Підозрілі") .. ":\n" .. (#lines > 0 and table.concat(lines, "\n") or tr("немає"))
	end

	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(1)
			local now = os.clock()
			for plr, rec in suspRec do
				if plr.Parent ~= Players then
					removeTag(rec)
					suspRec[plr] = nil
				else
					if rec.score > 0 and now - rec.decayT >= 20 then
						rec.score -= 1
						rec.decayT = now
					end
					local flagged = rec.score >= S.SuspThreshold
					if not flagged then rec.notified = false end

					local head = plr.Character and plr.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
					if flagged and S.Susp and S.SuspTags and gateOpen and head then
						if not rec.tag or not rec.tag.Parent or rec.tag.Adornee ~= head then
							removeTag(rec)
							local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
							bb.Adornee = head
							bb.AlwaysOnTop = true
							bb.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(90, 20)
							bb.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 2.8, 0)
							bb.Parent = defFolder
							local l = makeText(bb, UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), UDim2.new(), "AIM?", 14,
								Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 90), FONT_B, Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, true)
							l.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.3
							rec.tag = bb
						end
					else
						removeTag(rec)
					end
				end
			end
			refreshSuspInfo()
		end
	end)

	local VEHICLE_WORDS = {
		"vehicle", "car", "tank", "truck", "jeep", "heli", "boat", "bike", "apc", "buggy",
		"транспорт", "машин", "танк", "авто", "вертол", "човен",
	}

	local function isVehicleSeat(seat)
		if seat:IsA("VehicleSeat") then return true end
		local m = seat
		while m and m ~= workspace do
			if CollectionService:HasTag(m, "Vehicle") then return true end
			local n = string.lower(m.Name)
			for _, w in VEHICLE_WORDS do
				if string.find(n, w, 1, true) then return true end
			end
			m = m.Parent
		end
		return false
	end

	local function seatOwnerPlayer(seat)
		local model = seat:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
		while model do
			local plr = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model)
			if plr then return plr end
			local parent = model.Parent
			model = parent and parent:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model") or nil
		end
		return nil
	end

	local function forcedSeat(seat)
		if S.SitMode == 3 then return true end
		if S.SitMode == 2 then return not isVehicleSeat(seat) end

		local owner = seatOwnerPlayer(seat)
		if owner and owner ~= player then return true end
		if not isVehicleSeat(seat) and seat.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude > S.SitSpeed then return true end
		return false
	end

	local groundCF, airSince = nil, nil
	local flickPrev, flickRoot = nil, nil
	local lastUnsit = 0

	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
		if not gateOpen then return end
		local now = os.clock()
		local char = player.Character
		local root, hum = getRoot(char), getHum(char)

		if not (root and hum and hum.Health > 0) then
			groundCF, airSince, flickPrev, flickRoot = nil, nil, nil, nil
			return
		end
		if flickRoot ~= root then
			flickRoot, flickPrev, groundCF, airSince = root, nil, nil, nil
		end

		local pos = root.Position
		local vel = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
		local seat = hum.SeatPart

		if S.AntiSit and seat and now - lastUnsit > 0.4 and forcedSeat(seat) then
			lastUnsit = now
			hum.Sit = false
			hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
			local weld = seat:FindFirstChild("SeatWeld")
			if weld then pcall(function() weld:Destroy() end) end
			defNote("sit", S.SitNotify, "Анти-сидіння: вас зняли з сидіння", Color3.fromRGB(255, 160, 80), 2)
			seat = nil
		end

		local grounded = hum.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air
		if grounded or seat then
			airSince = nil
			if grounded and not seat and vel.Y > -20 then groundCF = root.CFrame end
		else
			airSince = airSince or now
		end

		if S.AntiFall and groundCF and not seat and not S.Fly and now > selfMoveUntil then
			local h = pos.Y - groundCF.Position.Y
			local airTime = airSince and (now - airSince) or 0
			local ownLift = S.JumpOn or S.InfJump
			local tooHigh = (not ownLift) and airTime > 0.8 and h > S.FallHeight
			local tooFast = (not S.GravityOn) and vel.Y < -S.FallSpeed and h > 60
			if tooHigh or tooFast then
				markSelf(0.5)
				root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
				root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
				char:PivotTo(groundCF + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
				airSince, flickPrev = nil, nil
				defNote("fall", S.FallNotify, "Анти-падіння: повернуто на землю", Color3.fromRGB(255, 160, 80), 2)
				return
			end
		end

		local reverted = false
		if S.AntiFlick and flickPrev and not seat and now - charBorn > 2 and now > selfMoveUntil then
			local d = (pos - flickPrev).Magnitude
			local limit = math.max(S.FlickDist, (vel.Magnitude + 100) * dt * 2)
			if d >= limit then
				local near = not S.FlickEnemyOnly
				if not near then
					for _, plr in Players:GetPlayers() do
						if plr ~= player and not isTeammate(plr) then
							local r = getRoot(plr.Character)
							if r and ((r.Position - pos).Magnitude <= 40 or (r.Position - flickPrev).Magnitude <= 40) then
								near = true
								break
							end
						end
					end
				end
				if near then
					if S.FlickRevert then
						markSelf(0.5)
						root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
						char:PivotTo(CFrame.new(flickPrev) * root.CFrame.Rotation)
						reverted = true
						defNote("flick", true, "Анти-ТП-флік: повернуто назад", Color3.fromRGB(255, 160, 80), 2)
					else
						defNote("flick", true, "Анти-ТП-флік: вас перемістили", Color3.fromRGB(255, 160, 80), 2)
					end
				end
			end
		end
		if not reverted then flickPrev = pos end
	end)

	local abSaved = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
	local guiSaved, guiConns = {}, {}

	local function clampProp(inst, prop, limit, isMax)
		local cur = inst[prop]
		if (isMax and cur > limit) or ((not isMax) and cur < limit) then
			local s = abSaved[inst]
			if not s then
				s = {}
				abSaved[inst] = s
			end
			if s[prop] == nil then s[prop] = cur end
			inst[prop] = limit
			return true
		end
		return false
	end

	local function clampEffects(container)
		local changed = false
		for _, inst in container:GetChildren() do
			if inst:IsA("BlurEffect") then
				changed = clampProp(inst, "Size", S.AbBlur, true) or changed
			elseif inst:IsA("ColorCorrectionEffect") then
				changed = clampProp(inst, "Brightness", S.AbBright, true) or changed
				changed = clampProp(inst, "Brightness", -0.8, false) or changed
			elseif inst:IsA("BloomEffect") then
				changed = clampProp(inst, "Intensity", S.AbBright * 4, true) or changed
			elseif inst:IsA("SunRaysEffect") then
				changed = clampProp(inst, "Intensity", 0.4, true) or changed
			elseif inst:IsA("Atmosphere") then
				changed = clampProp(inst, "Density", 0.6, true) or changed
				changed = clampProp(inst, "Haze", 6, true) or changed
			end
		end
		return changed
	end

	local function restoreEffects()
		for inst, props in abSaved do
			if inst.Parent then
				for prop, v in props do
					pcall(function() inst[prop] = v end)
				end
			end
			abSaved[inst] = nil
		end
	end

	local function restoreGui()
		for inst, s in guiSaved do
			if inst.Parent then pcall(function() inst[s.prop] = s.value end) end
			if guiConns[inst] then guiConns[inst]:Disconnect() end
			guiConns[inst] = nil
			guiSaved[inst] = nil
		end
	end

	local function guiIgnored(inst)
		local sg = inst:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("ScreenGui")
		if not sg then return true end
		if string.sub(sg.Name, 1, 7) == "FunMode" then return true end
		local lname = string.lower(sg.Name)
		for token in string.gmatch(string.lower(S.AbIgnore), "[^,;]+") do
			token = string.gsub(token, "^%s+", "")
			token = string.gsub(token, "%s+$", "")
			if token ~= "" and string.find(lname, token, 1, true) then return true end
		end
		return false
	end

	local function checkGui(inst)
		if not (S.AntiBlind and S.AbGui and gateOpen) then return end
		if not inst.Parent or guiSaved[inst] then return end
		if os.clock() - charBorn < 3 then return end

		local cam = getCamera()
		if not cam then return end
		local isFrame = inst:IsA("Frame")
		local isImg = inst:IsA("ImageLabel")
		if not (isFrame or isImg) then return end

		local vp, sz = cam.ViewportSize, inst.AbsoluteSize
		if sz.X < vp.X * 0.8 or sz.Y < vp.Y * 0.8 then return end
		if guiIgnored(inst) then return end

		local c, t, prop
		if isFrame then
			c, t, prop = inst.BackgroundColor3, inst.BackgroundTransparency, "BackgroundTransparency"
		else
			c, t, prop = inst.ImageColor3, inst.ImageTransparency, "ImageTransparency"
		end
		if (c.R + c.G + c.B) / 3 < 0.82 or t > 0.6 then return end

		guiSaved[inst] = { prop = prop, value = t }
		inst[prop] = 0.93
		guiConns[inst] = inst:GetPropertyChangedSignal(prop):Connect(function()
			if S.AntiBlind and S.AbGui and gateOpen and inst[prop] < 0.93 then
				inst[prop] = 0.93
			end
		end)
		defNote("blind", S.AfNotify, "Анти-сліпота: ефект приглушено", Color3.fromRGB(255, 160, 80), 3)
	end

	playerGui.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(inst)
		if S.AntiBlind and S.AbGui and (inst:IsA("Frame") or inst:IsA("ImageLabel")) then
			task.delay(0.05, checkGui, inst)
		end
	end)

	local function blindTick()
		if S.AntiBlind and gateOpen then
			local c1 = clampEffects(Lighting)
			local cam = getCamera()
			local c2 = cam and clampEffects(cam) or false
			if c1 or c2 then
				defNote("blind", S.AfNotify, "Анти-сліпота: ефект приглушено", Color3.fromRGB(255, 160, 80), 3)
			end
		elseif next(abSaved) ~= nil then
			restoreEffects()
		end
		if not (S.AntiBlind and S.AbGui and gateOpen) and next(guiSaved) ~= nil then
			restoreGui()
		end
	end

	local slowT = 0
	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
		slowT += dt
		if slowT < 0.1 then return end
		slowT = 0
		updateMarkers()
		updateAimWarn()
		blindTick()
	end)

	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(plr)
		track[plr], enemyCd[plr], awRec[plr] = nil, nil, nil
		clearMarker(plr)
		local rec = suspRec[plr]
		if rec then
			removeTag(rec)
			suspRec[plr] = nil
		end
	end)
end)

safeRun("safe-spot", function()
	local SAFE_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(80, 220, 140)

	local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = "FunModeSafe"
	folder.Parent = workspace

	local objs = {}
	local label
	local lastGo = 0

	local function clearMarker()
		for _, o in objs do
			if o.Parent then o:Destroy() end
		end
		objs, label = {}, nil
	end

	local function newPart(size, cf, transparency, shape)
		local p = Instance.new("Part")
		p.Anchored = true
		p.CanCollide, p.CanQuery, p.CanTouch = false, false, false
		p.CastShadow = false
		p.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
		p.Color = SAFE_COLOR
		p.Transparency = transparency
		if shape then p.Shape = shape end
		p.Size = size
		p.CFrame = cf
		p.Parent = folder
		objs[#objs + 1] = p
		return p
	end

	local function buildMarker(groundPos)
		clearMarker()

		local ring = newPart(Vector3.new(0.2, 7, 7),
			CFrame.new(groundPos + Vector3.new(0, 0.15, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90)),
			0.2, Enum.PartType.Cylinder)
		TweenService:Create(ring,
			TweenInfo.new(1.1, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, -1, true),
			{ Transparency = 0.75 }):Play()

		local pillar = newPart(Vector3.new(0.5, 26, 0.5),
			CFrame.new(groundPos + Vector3.new(0, 13, 0)), 0.55)

		local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
		bb.Adornee = pillar
		bb.AlwaysOnTop = true
		bb.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(150, 20)
		bb.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 15, 0)
		bb.MaxDistance = 1e5
		bb.Parent = pillar
		label = makeText(bb, UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), UDim2.new(), "SAFE", 14, SAFE_COLOR, FONT_B,
			Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, true)
		label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.3
	end

	local function findGround(root, char)
		local params = RaycastParams.new()
		params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
		params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { char, folder }
		local hit = workspace:Raycast(root.Position + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0), Vector3.new(0, -300, 0), params)
		return hit and hit.Position or nil
	end

	local WARN = Color3.fromRGB(255, 160, 80)

	Safe.create = function()
		local char = player.Character
		local root, hum = getRoot(char), getHum(char)
		if not (root and hum and hum.Health > 0) then
			toast(tr("Немає живого персонажа"), WARN, true)
			return
		end
		local ground = findGround(root, char)
		if not ground then
			toast(tr("Не вдалося: під вами немає землі"), WARN, true)
			return
		end

		local lift
		if hum.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air then
			lift = root.Position.Y - ground.Y + 0.4
		elseif hum.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6 then
			lift = 3.4
		else
			lift = hum.HipHeight + root.Size.Y / 2 + 0.4
		end

		Safe.cf = CFrame.new(ground + Vector3.new(0, lift, 0)) * root.CFrame.Rotation
		buildMarker(ground)
		applyVisuals()
		toast(tr("Безпечне місце створено"), SAFE_COLOR, true)
	end

	Safe.go = function()
		if not Safe.cf then
			toast(tr("Спершу створіть безпечне місце"), WARN, true)
			return
		end
		local char = player.Character
		local root, hum = getRoot(char), getHum(char)
		if not (root and hum and hum.Health > 0) then return end
		if os.clock() - lastGo < 0.4 then return end
		lastGo = os.clock()

		if hum.SeatPart then hum.Sit = false end
		markSelf(0.9)
		root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
		root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
		char:PivotTo(Safe.cf)
		toast(tr("ТП у безпечне місце"), SAFE_COLOR, true)
	end

	Safe.delete = function()
		if not Safe.cf then return end
		Safe.cf = nil
		clearMarker()
		applyVisuals()
		toast(tr("Безпечне місце видалено"), C_DIM, true)
	end

	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(0.2)
			local want = gateOpen and workspace or nil
			if folder.Parent ~= want then folder.Parent = want end
			if label and Safe.cf then
				local root = getRoot(player.Character)
				if root then
					label.Text = string.format(tr("SAFE · %d ст"), math.floor((root.Position - Safe.cf.Position).Magnitude))
				end
			end
		end
	end)
end)

safeRun("visuals", function()
	local overlay = UI.overlay
	local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = "FunModeVisuals"
	folder.Parent = overlay

	local pool = {}
	local rp = RaycastParams.new()
	rp.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude

	local function mkFrame(parent)
		local f = Instance.new("Frame")
		f.BorderSizePixel = 0
		f.Visible = false
		f.Parent = parent
		return f
	end

	local function create()
		local e = {}
		e.box = mkFrame(folder)
		e.box.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		e.stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
		e.stroke.Parent = e.box
		e.barBg = mkFrame(folder)
		e.barBg.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 15)
		e.barFill = mkFrame(e.barBg)
		e.barFill.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1)
		e.barFill.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1)
		e.tracer = mkFrame(folder)
		e.tracer.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		e.dot = mkFrame(folder)
		e.dot.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		corner(e.dot, 9999)
		e.arrow = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		e.arrow.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		e.arrow.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(28, 28)
		e.arrow.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		e.arrow.Text = ">"
		e.arrow.Font = FONT_B
		e.arrow.TextSize = 24
		e.arrow.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.3
		e.arrow.Visible = false
		e.arrow.Parent = folder
		return e
	end

	local function hide(e)
		e.box.Visible, e.barBg.Visible, e.tracer.Visible, e.dot.Visible, e.arrow.Visible = false, false, false, false, false
	end

	local function destroy(char)
		local e = pool[char]
		if e then
			for _, o in { e.box, e.barBg, e.tracer, e.dot, e.arrow } do o:Destroy() end
			pool[char] = nil
		end
	end

	RunService:BindToRenderStep("FunModeVisuals", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 4, function()
		local cam = getCamera()
		local any = S.EspBox or S.EspTracer or S.EspHead or S.EspArrows
		if not (gateOpen and cam and any) then
			for char in pool do destroy(char) end
			return
		end

		local vp = cam.ViewportSize
		local center = vp / 2
		local myChar = player.Character
		rp.FilterDescendantsInstances = myChar and { myChar } or {}
		local camPos = cam.CFrame.Position
		local seen = {}

		local list = collect(false)
		if S.EspNPC and not S.IncludeNPCs then
			for _, c in npcList do
				if c.Parent then list[#list + 1] = { char = c } end
			end
		end
		for _, t in list do
			local char, plr = t.char, t.plr
			local hum, root = getHum(char), getRoot(char)
			if hum and root and hum.Health > 0 and (plr or S.EspNPC) and char:IsDescendantOf(workspace) and not (S.EspHideTeam and isTeammate(plr)) then
				local dist = (root.Position - camPos).Magnitude
				if not (S.EspMaxDist < 5000 and dist > S.EspMaxDist) then
					seen[char] = true
					local e = pool[char]
					if not e then e = create() pool[char] = e end

					local color3 = nil
					if S.EspVisCheck then
						local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head") or root
						local h = workspace:Raycast(camPos, head.Position - camPos, rp)
						local visible = h == nil or h.Instance:IsDescendantOf(char)
						color3 = visible and Color3.fromRGB(60, 255, 90) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60)
					end

					local headPart = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
					local up = Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
					local topPos = (headPart and headPart.Position or root.Position + up * 2) + up * ((headPart and headPart.Size.Y / 2 or 0.5) + 0.15)
					local feet = hum.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6 and 3 or (hum.HipHeight + root.Size.Y / 2)
					local botPos = root.Position - up * (feet + 0.1)
					local tsp, tOn = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(topPos)
					local bsp, bOn = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(botPos)
					local rootSp, rootOn = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(root.Position)
					local onScreen = tsp.Z > 0 and bsp.Z > 0 and rootSp.Z > 0 and (tOn or bOn or rootOn)
					local minX, minY, maxX, maxY = 0, 0, 0, 0
					if onScreen then
						local h = math.max(bsp.Y - tsp.Y, 4)
						local w = h * 0.55
						minX, maxX = rootSp.X - w / 2, rootSp.X + w / 2
						minY, maxY = tsp.Y, tsp.Y + h
					end
					local frac = math.clamp(hum.Health / math.max(hum.MaxHealth, 1), 0, 1)

					if S.EspBox and onScreen then
						e.box.Visible = true
						e.box.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(minX, minY)
						e.box.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(maxX - minX, maxY - minY)
						e.stroke.Thickness = S.EspBoxThick
						e.stroke.Color = color3 or colorOf(S.EspBoxColor)
						if S.EspBar then
							local h = maxY - minY
							e.barBg.Visible = true
							e.barBg.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(minX - 6, minY)
							e.barBg.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(3, h)
							e.barFill.Visible = true
							e.barFill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, frac)
							e.barFill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60):Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(60, 255, 90), frac)
						else
							e.barBg.Visible = false
						end
					else
						e.box.Visible, e.barBg.Visible = false, false
					end

					if S.EspTracer and onScreen then
						local from
						if S.EspTracerFrom == 1 then from = Vector2.new(vp.X / 2, vp.Y)
						elseif S.EspTracerFrom == 2 then from = center
						else from = getAimPoint() end
						local to = Vector2.new((minX + maxX) / 2, maxY)
						local diff = to - from
						e.tracer.Visible = true
						e.tracer.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(diff.Magnitude, 1)
						e.tracer.Position = UDim2.fromOffset((from.X + to.X) / 2, (from.Y + to.Y) / 2)
						e.tracer.Rotation = math.deg(math.atan2(diff.Y, diff.X))
						e.tracer.BackgroundColor3 = color3 or colorOf(S.EspTracerColor)
					else
						e.tracer.Visible = false
					end

safeRun("cheat-scanner", function()

	local FLAG_KEY = { speed = "DtSpeed", fly = "DtFly", noclip = "DtNoclip", spin = "DtSpin", hitbox = "DtHitbox", invis = "DtInvis", lag = "DtLag" }
	local FLAG_ORDER = { "speed", "fly", "noclip", "spin", "hitbox", "invis", "lag" }

	folder.Name = "FunModeScan"
	folder.Parent = playerGui

	local rp = RaycastParams.new()
	rp.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude

	local function newRec()
		return { fc = {}, dec = {}, notified = {}, speedT = 0, flyT = 0, spinT = 0, stillT = 0, nc = {}, invisT = 0, skipUntil = 0 }
	end

	local quietUntil, lastFrame, myLastPos = 0, os.clock(), nil
	local StatsService = game:GetService("Stats")

	local function hit(plr, rec, flag, now)
		if now < quietUntil then return end
		if now - (rec.lastHit and rec.lastHit[flag] or 0) < 1.2 then return end
		rec.lastHit = rec.lastHit or {}
		rec.lastHit[flag] = now
		rec.fc[flag] = (rec.fc[flag] or 0) + 1
		rec.dec[flag] = now
		if rec.fc[flag] >= S.DtThreshold and not rec.notified[flag] then
			rec.notified[flag] = true
			defNote("scan_" .. plr.UserId .. flag, S.DtNotify, "Підозра (%s): %s", RED, 10, FLAG_TEXT[flag], plr.DisplayName)
		end
	end

	local function flagged(rec, flag)
		return (rec.fc[flag] or 0) >= S.DtThreshold and S[FLAG_KEY[flag]]
	end

	local function removeGui(rec)
		if rec.tag then rec.tag:Destroy() rec.tag = nil end
		if rec.mark then rec.mark:Destroy() rec.mark = nil end
	end

	local function stateIs(hum, ...)
		local ok, st = pcall(function() return hum:GetState() end)

		end

						rec.skipUntil = now + 3

					if rec.pos then

						local delta = pos - rec.pos
						local dist = delta.Magnitude

						if dist > 60 then rec.skipUntil = now + 1.5 end
						local skip = now < rec.skipUntil
						local seated = hum.SeatPart ~= nil or hum.Sit
						local airborne = hum.FloorMaterial == Enum.Material.Air

								Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics, Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll, Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp)

						end
					end

					end

					if S.DtFreeze then

						end

							local big = math.max(root.Size.X, root.Size.Y, root.Size.Z) > S.DtHitboxSize
								or (head and math.max(head.Size.X, head.Size.Y, head.Size.Z) > S.DtHitboxSize * 0.8)
							rec.bigT = big and (rec.bigT or 0) + 1 or 0
							if big and rec.bigT >= 3 and now >= quietUntil then
								rec.fc.hitbox, rec.dec.hitbox = S.DtThreshold, now
								if not rec.notified.hitbox then

						end

									end
								end
							else
								rec.invisT = 0
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end)

		for plr, rec in recs do

			for _, f in FLAG_ORDER do

safeRun("sky", function()

		{ clock = 17.5, amb = C(150, 100, 140), out = C(190, 120, 170), atm = C(255, 150, 210), dec = C(200, 90, 170), dens = 0.45, haze = 2, tint = C(255, 210, 240), sat = 0.3, fog = C(255, 170, 220), fe = 40000, bri = 2.2, stars = 0 },

		{ clock = 15, amb = C(60, 110, 50), out = C(90, 150, 70), atm = C(120, 255, 90), dec = C(60, 150, 40), dens = 0.5, haze = 2.5, tint = C(190, 255, 170), sat = 0.25, fog = C(110, 200, 80), fe = 1500, bri = 2, stars = 0 },
		{ clock = 0, amb = C(70, 40, 120), out = C(90, 50, 160), atm = C(150, 70, 255), dec = C(40, 200, 255), dens = 0.4, haze = 1.5, tint = C(210, 160, 255), sat = 0.4, fog = C(60, 20, 120), fe = 8000, bri = 1.5, stars = 2500 },
	}
	local lastPreset, lastOn
	local skyClock = 0
	local lastT = os.clock()

	local LP = { "ClockTime", "Ambient", "OutdoorAmbient", "Brightness", "FogColor", "FogEnd", "FogStart", "ExposureCompensation", "ColorShift_Top", "ColorShift_Bottom" }
	local saved = nil
	local atmSaved = nil
	local ownAtm, tintFx
	local skySaved = {}

	local function findAtm()
		for _, o in Lighting:GetChildren() do
			if o:IsA("Atmosphere") and o ~= ownAtm then return o end
		end
	end

	local function engage()
		saved = {}
		for _, p in LP do saved[p] = Lighting[p] end
		local a = findAtm()
		if a then
			atmSaved = { inst = a }
			for _, p in { "Color", "Decay", "Density", "Haze", "Offset", "Glare" } do atmSaved[p] = a[p] end
		else
			ownAtm = Instance.new("Atmosphere")
			ownAtm.Name = "FunModeSkyAtm"
			ownAtm.Parent = Lighting
		end
		tintFx = Instance.new("ColorCorrectionEffect")
		tintFx.Name = "FunModeSkyTint"
		tintFx.Parent = Lighting
		for _, o in Lighting:GetChildren() do
			if o:IsA("Sky") then skySaved[o] = o.StarCount end
		end
	end

	local function disengage()
		if saved then
			for p, v in saved do pcall(function() Lighting[p] = v end) end
			saved = nil
		end
		if atmSaved and atmSaved.inst and atmSaved.inst.Parent then
			for p, v in atmSaved do
				if p ~= "inst" then pcall(function() atmSaved.inst[p] = v end) end
			end
		end
		atmSaved = nil
		if ownAtm then ownAtm:Destroy() ownAtm = nil end
		if tintFx then tintFx:Destroy() tintFx = nil end
		for sky, n in skySaved do
			if sky.Parent then pcall(function() sky.StarCount = n end) end
			skySaved[sky] = nil
		end
	end

	local function currentPreset(now)
		local idx = S.SkyPreset
		if idx == 9 then

			local h = (now * 0.05) % 1
			local col = Color3.fromHSV(h, 0.7, 1)
			return { clock = 17, amb = Color3.fromHSV(h, 0.4, 0.55), out = Color3.fromHSV(h, 0.4, 0.7), atm = col,
				dec = Color3.fromHSV((h + 0.5) % 1, 0.8, 0.6), dens = S.SkyDensity, haze = 2, tint = Color3.fromHSV(h, 0.25, 1),
				sat = 0.3, fog = col, fe = 40000, bri = 2, stars = 0 }
		elseif idx == 10 then
			local col = COLORS[S.SkyColor][2]
			return { clock = S.SkyTime, amb = col:Lerp(Color3.new(0.2, 0.2, 0.25), 0.7), out = col:Lerp(Color3.new(0.3, 0.3, 0.35), 0.6),
				atm = col, dec = col:Lerp(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 0.5), dens = S.SkyDensity, haze = 1.5, tint = col:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.7),
				sat = 0.15, fog = col, fe = 60000, bri = 2, stars = 0 }
		end
		return PRESETS[idx]
	end

	local function apply(now, dt)
		local pr = currentPreset(now)
		if not pr then return end
		local clock = pr.clock
		if S.SkyCycle > 0 then
			skyClock = (skyClock + dt * S.SkyCycle * 0.4) % 24
			clock = (pr.clock + skyClock) % 24
		end
		Lighting.ClockTime = clock
		Lighting.Ambient = pr.amb
		Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = pr.out
		Lighting.Brightness = pr.bri
		Lighting.FogColor = pr.fog
		Lighting.FogStart = 0
		Lighting.FogEnd = pr.fe
		local atm = ownAtm or (atmSaved and atmSaved.inst)
		if atm and atm.Parent then
			atm.Color = pr.atm
			atm.Decay = pr.dec
			atm.Density = (S.SkyPreset == 9 or S.SkyPreset == 10) and S.SkyDensity or pr.dens
			atm.Haze = math.min(pr.haze, 4)
			atm.Offset = 0.25
			atm.Glare = 0.2
		end
		if tintFx then
			tintFx.TintColor = pr.tint
			tintFx.Saturation = pr.sat
		end
		for sky in skySaved do
			if sky.Parent then sky.StarCount = S.SkyStars and pr.stars or 0 end
		end
	end

	local acc = 0
	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		local now = os.clock()
		local dt = now - lastT
		lastT = now
		local on = S.SkyOn and gateOpen and not splashActive
		if on then
			if not lastOn then engage() skyClock = 0 end
			if lastPreset ~= S.SkyPreset then skyClock = 0 lastPreset = S.SkyPreset end
			acc += dt
			if acc >= 0.05 then
				apply(now, acc)
				acc = 0
			end
		elseif lastOn then
			disengage()
		end
		lastOn = on
	end)
end)

		if not pulled then return end
		local cam, myRoot = getCamera(), getRoot(player.Character)
		if not (cam and myRoot and pulled.Parent and isAlive(pulled) and os.clock() < untilT and gateOpen) then
			release()
			return
		end
		pulledChars[pulled] = math.huge
		pcall(function() pulled:SetAttribute("ZenithLocalMove", os.clock() + 2) end)

		if fixedCF then pcall(function() pulled:PivotTo(fixedCF) end) end
	end)

	pullStop = function()
		if pulled then release() end
	end

	pullToggle = function()
		if pulled then
			release()
			toast(tr("Притяг вимкнено"), ACCENT, true)
			return
		end

		local oldTeam = S.IgnoreTeam
		if S.PullTeam then S.IgnoreTeam = false end
		local ok, t = pcall(getTarget, S.PullUseFov)
		S.IgnoreTeam = oldTeam
		if not (ok and t) then
			toast(tr("Немає цілі для притягу"), Color3.fromRGB(215, 80, 85), true)
			return
		end

		local cam, myRoot = getCamera(), getRoot(player.Character)
		local tRoot, tHum = getRoot(t.char), getHum(t.char)
		if not (cam and myRoot and tRoot and tHum) then return end
		local look = cam.CFrame.LookVector
		local flat = Vector3.new(look.X, 0, look.Z)
		if flat.Magnitude < 0.01 then flat = myRoot.CFrame.LookVector end
		flat = flat.Unit
		local pos = myRoot.Position + flat * S.PullDist
		local feet = tHum.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6 and 3 or (tHum.HipHeight + tRoot.Size.Y / 2)
		local gp = RaycastParams.new()
		gp.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
		gp.FilterDescendantsInstances = { player.Character, t.char }
		local hit = workspace:Raycast(pos + Vector3.new(0, 6, 0), Vector3.new(0, -40, 0), gp)
		local y = hit and (hit.Position.Y + feet) or pos.Y
		pos = Vector3.new(pos.X, y, pos.Z)
		fixedCF = CFrame.lookAt(pos, Vector3.new(myRoot.Position.X, pos.Y, myRoot.Position.Z))
		pulled, untilT = t.char, os.clock() + S.PullTime
		pulledChars[pulled] = math.huge
		toast(string.format(tr("Притяг: %s"), t.plr and t.plr.DisplayName or t.char.Name), ACCENT, true)
	end
end)

safeRun("recolor", function()
	local MATS = { nil, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, Enum.Material.Neon, Enum.Material.Metal, Enum.Material.Glass }
	local saved = {}
	local tracked = {}
	local lastRun = 0

	local function remember(inst, prop)
		local rec = saved[inst]
		if not rec then rec = {} saved[inst] = rec end
		if rec[prop] == nil then rec[prop] = inst[prop] end
	end

	local function setProp(inst, prop, value)
		local ok = pcall(function()
			remember(inst, prop)
			inst[prop] = value
		end)
		return ok
	end

	local function restoreAll(onlyChar)
		for inst, rec in saved do
			if not onlyChar or inst:IsDescendantOf(onlyChar) or not inst.Parent then
				for prop, v in rec do pcall(function() inst[prop] = v end) end
				saved[inst] = nil
			end
		end
		if onlyChar then tracked[onlyChar] = nil else tracked = {} end
	end

	local function scan(char)
		local info = tracked[char]
		if not info then info = { parts = {}, t = -10 } tracked[char] = info end
		if os.clock() - info.t < 0.6 then return info end
		info.t = os.clock()
		local parts = {}
		for _, d in char:GetDescendants() do
			if d:IsA("BasePart") then
				if d.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then parts[#parts + 1] = d end
				if d:IsA("MeshPart") and d.TextureID ~= "" then setProp(d, "TextureID", "") end
			elseif d:IsA("SurfaceAppearance") then

				pcall(function()
					remember(d, "Parent")
					d.Parent = nil
				end)
			elseif d:IsA("Shirt") then setProp(d, "ShirtTemplate", "")
			elseif d:IsA("Pants") then setProp(d, "PantsTemplate", "")
			elseif d:IsA("ShirtGraphic") then setProp(d, "Graphic", "")
			end
		end
		info.parts = parts
		return info
	end

	local function wanted(plr)
		if plr == player then return S.ChrWho == 4 end
		if S.ChrWho == 1 or S.ChrWho == 3 then return true end
		if S.ChrWho == 2 then return not isTeammate(plr) end
		return false
	end

	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		if not (S.Chr and gateOpen) or splashActive then
			if next(saved) ~= nil or next(tracked) ~= nil then restoreAll() end
			return
		end
		local now = os.clock()
		if now - lastRun < 1 / 30 then return end
		lastRun = now

		local c1, c2 = CHR_COLORS[S.ChrColor][2], CHR_COLORS[S.ChrColor2][2]
		local mat = MATS[S.ChrMat]
		local seen = {}
		for _, plr in Players:GetPlayers() do
			local char = plr.Character
			if char and char.Parent and wanted(plr) then
				seen[char] = true
				local info = scan(char)
				local n = #info.parts
				for i, part in info.parts do
					if part.Parent then
						local col
						if S.ChrStyle == 1 then
							col = c1
						elseif S.ChrStyle == 2 then
							col = Color3.fromHSV((now * 0.15 * S.ChrSpeed + i / math.max(n, 1) * 0.5) % 1, 0.9, 1)
						else
							local k = (math.sin(now * 2 * S.ChrSpeed + i * 0.35) + 1) / 2
							col = c1:Lerp(c2, k)
						end
						setProp(part, "Color", col)
						if mat then setProp(part, "Material", mat) end
						local rec = saved[part]
						if S.ChrAlpha > 0 then
							local orig = rec and rec.Transparency or part.Transparency
							setProp(part, "Transparency", math.max(orig, S.ChrAlpha))
						elseif rec and rec.Transparency ~= nil then
							part.Transparency = rec.Transparency
							rec.Transparency = nil
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end

		for char in tracked do
			if not seen[char] then restoreAll(char) end
		end
	end)
end)

safeRun("third-person", function()
	local saved = nil
	local lastDist, pendingUntil = nil, 0

	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		if S.Tpv and gateOpen then
			if not saved then
				saved = {
					mode = player.CameraMode,
					min = player.CameraMinZoomDistance,
					max = player.CameraMaxZoomDistance,
				}
				lastDist = nil
			end
			player.CameraMode = Enum.CameraMode.Classic

			if lastDist ~= S.TpvDist then

				lastDist = S.TpvDist
				pendingUntil = os.clock() + 0.2
				player.CameraMinZoomDistance = S.TpvDist
				player.CameraMaxZoomDistance = S.TpvDist
			elseif os.clock() >= pendingUntil then
				if S.TpvFree then
					player.CameraMinZoomDistance = 4
					player.CameraMaxZoomDistance = 200
				else
					player.CameraMinZoomDistance = S.TpvDist
					player.CameraMaxZoomDistance = S.TpvDist
				end
			end
		elseif saved then
			player.CameraMode = saved.mode
			player.CameraMinZoomDistance = saved.min
			player.CameraMaxZoomDistance = saved.max
			saved = nil
			lastDist = nil
		end
	end)
end)
